par sems pa mi mnga'/ thugs la dgyes71)pa mi mnga'/ thugs la gnod pa mi mnga'/ thugs la〈pe'ajug pa mi mnga'/ thugs la norab tu rgyu bakhemi mnga' / thugs53)la rtog pa mi mnga'/ thugs la rnam par rtog pa mi mnga'/thugs la yongs su rtog paponami mnga'/ thugs la zhimu gnas mi mnga'/ thugs la lhag mthong mi mnga'/ thugs 8)rnam par shes pa'i rjes su 'brang ba mi mnga'/rang gi thugs la gnas pa mi mnga'/ gzhan gyis9sems la lta 7ba mi mnga'/thugs mig la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs gzugs la gnas pa mi mnga'/thugs sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs chos la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs dmigs pa la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs yid la gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs nang na gnas pa mi mnga'/ thugs phyi rol na gnas pa mi mnga'o/ /thugs de chos rnams la mi 'jug go/ / thugs de ye shes la mi 'jug go/ /(1thugs de 'das pa'amanya / ma 'ongs pa'amanyanye/ da ltar byung ba la mi rtog go/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de 1 bzhin gshegs pa ni de ltar thugs yongs su dag pa ste/ thugs kyis chos gang yang mngon par mi sgrub la chos thams cad la yang de'i ye shes ma chags ma thogs pa 32'jug go/ /rang gi thugs yongs su dag pas sems can gang gi sems kyang yongs su ma dag par mi gzigs te/ de gzigs kyang gzigs pa ma yin zhing rnam par 7mi rtog go/ /gzigs kyang spros par mi mdzad do/ /gzigs pas kun 1 gzigs pa dang rnam par gzigs pa mi gzigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes des18ni sha'i mig gi 10mthong ba dang ldan pa ma yin/ lha'i mig gi 2 mthong ba dang ldan pa ma 39—397

yin / shes rab kyi mig gis1)mthong ba dang ldan pa ma yin/ chos kyi mig gi⑧mthong ba dang ldan pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyishegazigs pa dang ldan pa ma yin/ lha'i rna ba'i shwathos pa dang ldan pa ma yin/ gzhan gyi sems la lta ba dang ldan pa ma yin/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang ldan pa ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba dang ldan pa ma yin/ zag pa zad pa shes pasnyedang ldan pa yang 6)ma yin la/ de chos thams cad57dang mi5nyeldan pa yang ma7yin te/chos thams cad la chags pa med par ldan pa 7yin no/ /de'i de bzhin gshegs 11pa'i ye shes kyi rgyun rnams ni bsgrimatshwa pa mi mnga' zhing lhun gyis grub la mngon par 12'du mdzad pasami mnga' bar〈sheganas so/ /sems can gyi spyod pa thams cad la yangatsha gzigs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba yang rab tu mkhyen to/ /de'i stobs bcu dang ske/ mi 'jigs 18pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa〈nyebargyad mkhyen pa yang bsnyel ba mi mnga' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos de dag ni lhun gyis grub cing bsgrim pa mi mnga' la mngon par 'du mdzad pa mi mnga' bar 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems dang yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang yang bral la ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas kyang mi 'dor ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi5) mdzad pa thams cad kyang mdzad la de'i chos thams cad la chags pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shes kyang gang du yang mi chags so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste dper na/de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis pa gang yin padza tede la ni sems kyang mi mnga'/ yid kyang mi mnga'/ rnam par shes pa yang mi mnga' / sku'i 'du byed kyang mi mnga'/ gsung gi 'du byed kyang mi mnga'/39wa 398

thugs kyi 'du byed0)kyang mi mnga' mod kyi/ (ge'adi lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu nyid kyisashesangs rgyas kyil )mdzad pa thams cad kyang mdzad do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang sprul pa dang mtshungs pas55)mnyam mo/ /sprul pa'i chos nyid kyis rnam par mi rtog go/ /de la sku'i rtsom56)pa dang / gsung gi rtsom pa dang / thugs kyi rtsom pa yang mi snang la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad kyang mdzad de/ de yang lhun gyis grub cing bsgrimadza )pa mi mnga' la mngon par 'du mdzad pa mi mnga' bas mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid du chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas tegen/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kyang sems can la thugs brtse 9)bas de bzhin du bstan to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ni 'dus byas la gnas pa ma yin/ 'dus ma byas la gnas pa ma yin/nyirme phung po la gnas pa ma yin/ khams la gnas pa ma yin/ skye mched la hunyaganas pa ma yin/ nang la gnas pa ma yin/phyi rolasnyil gnas pa ma yin/ dge ba la gnas pa ma yin/ mi dge ba la gnas pa ma yin/ 'jig rten pa la gnas pa ma yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la gnas pa ma yin/ kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa la gnas pa ma yin/ kha na ma tho ba med pa la gnas pa ma yin/ zag pa dang bcas pa la gnas pa ma yin / zag pa med pa la gnas pa ma yin/ 'das pa la gnas pa ma yin/ma 'ongs pa la5nyeganas pa ma yin/ da ltar byung ba la gnas pa ma yin/ so sor brtags pa la gnas pa ma yin/6 so sor brtags pa bem yin pa la gnas pa ma yin te/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes gnas pa mi 39—399

mnga'o / /de chos gang yang mngon par mi sgrub la sems can la thugs brtse0ra bas sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa dang / bsam pa rnams la yang de'i ye shes mthong ba chags pa mi mnga' zhing thogs pa mi mnga' ba 'jug naste / de yang lhun gyis grub cing bsgrim pa mi mnga' la mngon par 'du bya ba mi mnga' bas 'jug go/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba guste/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas kyang mi 'dor la sems can thams cad la sems rnam par rig par yang mdzad pas thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba'i le'u zhes bya bsreste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i (7bus 'di skad ces gsol to6/ /bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu dag na bskal pa bzang po pa'i ④byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shethad na da ltar tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyi slad 9na yang gsang ba pa'i nyi )bdag po mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā07ri'i bu bya ba 'di bsam gyis7)mi khyab kyis〈nyezhog shigs /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di la mgo rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta med kyi shā ri'istodabu gang dag dad cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa de dag gnas 'di la skrag par mi 'gyur rol/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ bdag de bzhin gshegs pa la yid ches par mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/39—400

shā ha)ri'i bu khyod kyis gsang (mib pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje (rtag tu nga'i 4 phyi bzhin 'brang ba mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de'5)ltar sangs rgyas kyi mthus mthong lags te/ 'di bdag gis sngon ni phyinam yang ma mthong ngo ske/ /bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i ⑦bu de bzhin du gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'di ni bskal pa bzang po pa'i shubyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyab rgyab na yang gnas te sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs dang / mngon par shes pa'i stobs kyis thams cad du gshe)yang lag na rdo rje'i 1 gzugs su kun du ston01to/ /shā hunyeri'i bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can ji snyed 'khod pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyi rgyab rgyab tu/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes nyusnyelag na rdo rje'i 14gzugs kun du bstan kyang des ye shes kyi byin gyi rlabs7yongs su rdzogs par bstan par mi 'gyur ro/ /shā miri'i bu khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i rgyab na lag na rdo rje 'dug pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 3 tshobadag gis da gdod mthong lags te/ sngon ni ma mthong ngo / /bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni de'i rgyab na rtag tu gnas na khyod kyis de ma mthong ba ma gtogs 18par byang chub sems dpa' 'am / brgya byin nam/ tshangs pa'am/ 'jig rten skyong ba gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas lhags pa de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i rgyab na lag na rdo rje rdo rjetshwa(thogs shing rtag tu 'dug par mthong ngo / /shā ni tshori'i bu byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / bskal 21pa bzang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sprul pa bye ba khrag khrig 22brgya stong dag sprul kyang de dag thams cad kyi rgyab na yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 39—401

gnas par snang ste byin gyi rlabs /nye de dag thams cad ni gsang ba pa'i bdag po'i yin no/ /shā 5ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa gang yin pa de dag gi⑧rgyab na yang 'di'i byin gyi rlabs (gekyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gnas te/ shā ga5)ri'i bu gsang ba pa'i⑧bdag po lag na rdo rje ni de ltar ye shes dang mngon par shes pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi ⑦stobs dang ldan no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 8)lag na rdo rje'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u zhes bya ⑨ste bcu pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa'i dka' ba spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskoratshwa )ba dang / bkod pa bstan pa lasatshwanyebartsams te/ de na pormad du byungarwanyeba'i rgyu gang dgatsobyung ba 8gang du khyod la mngon sum du gyur pa la 7khyod spobs par gyis shig /gsang ba pa'i bdag pos smras pa/ zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan bkod pa byung hunyeb ni tshad med de/ de dag ni che'i tshad bskal hunyepar gnas pas kyang rgyas par rnam paramu tshobye ste bstan par 27sla ba ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i dka'ar ba spyod pa ni〈nyernam pa gcig ma yin te/ mu stegs can gzhom pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' ( stespyad do/ /dka' thub dang / lus la yongs su gdungaspodab ji snyed dang /lus kyi spyod lam 2'ji snyed kyis pha rol mu stegs dunacan dag mngon par snyems rte39wa 402

pa de bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'amadzo)/ ches mchog tu gyur pa'i bya dka'atshabab dang / brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub gang dag de dag50gis bya bas kun tu bstan par mi nus pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpas kun tu bstan te/ zhi ba'i blo gros de la kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rkang pa ya gcig btsugs7te/ 'dug par mthong / kha cig gis ni lag pa bteg ste 'dug par mthong / kha cig gis ni nyi ma la0lta zhing 'dug par mthong kha cig gis ni gdung ba lngas gdung bar mthong / kha cig gis ni tsog tsog porapori'adug cing spong ba la sbyor bar brtson par mthong / kha cig gis ni rkang pa btsugs7te mi 'gul bar mthong / kha cig gis ni rkang pa gyen du bsgreng ste 'dug par mthong / kha cig gis ni khas bubasngo)tu 'dug par mthong / kha cig gis ni tsher ma'i steng na nyal bar mthong / kha cig gis ni ba lang gi lci ba'i nang na nyal bar mthong / kha cig gis ni rdo lebashel skyil mo krung5)bcas te 'dug par mthong / kha cig gis ni rtsig pa la snyes bopa dang / kha cig gis ni shing leb la snyes pa dang / kha cig gis ni gtun shing la snyesarmā 1pa dang /kha cig gis ni phyag dar khrod na7)nyal ba dang / kha cig gis ni nyi ma yongs su sgyur7ba dang / kha cig gis ni shing leb gyon pa dang / kha cig gis ni rtswa' ༵mun dza'i gos gyon51pa dang / kha cig gis ni rtswa bal pa dza'i gos gyonasho nyapa dang /kha cig gis ni rtswa (nyeku sha'i gos gyon rdu ripa dang / kha cig gis ni ri dgas kyi pags pa gyonamanyepa dang / kha cig gis ni rtswa tsi ra gyon 0pa dang / kha cig gisamanyeni sgrenarwa nyamor 'dug pa dang / kha cig gis ni rnamakhyedar bha'i gos gyonam pa dang ske/ kha cig gis ni shing51shun gyi gos gyon rtepa dang / kha cig gis ni sre dam 39—403

za ba dang / kha cig gis ni nas za bar mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni rtsa ba za ba dang / lo ma za ba 17dang / me tog za ba dang / 'bras bu za ba dang /sdong bu za ba 2dang / gzegs ma za ba dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba za ba dang / zhag drug smyung dab dang / sha mi za ba dang / rgya shug 4)za ba dang / nas shin te ltaza ba dang / ci tse za ba dang / mon sran sde'u za ba dang / mon sran gre'u57za ba dang / bra yos za ba dang / til za ba dang / 'bras skam za ba dang / chu 'thung ba tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang / mar gyi thigs pa tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang /sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa tsam gyis )'tsho ba dang / 'o ma'i thigs pa tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang ske/ kha cig gis ni zas mi za ba dang / kha cig gis rin)ni gnyid dang bral bar mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni 'dug pa 'ba' shig 9 tu mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni 'greng ba 'ba' shig 1 tu mthong ngo / /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar byang chub sems dpa' spyod lam de dag 11dang / dka' 12ba spyod pa tshad med pa gzhan dag kyang ston te/lha/ lo drug tshang bar 1 spyod lam gcig kyang ma 'khrugs par thams cad rdzogs par bstan par gyur boto/ /brtul zhugasam shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa dang / brtson 'grus shin tu sbyangs pa dang / dka' thub shin tu brtan pos 1 lo drug tu brtul zhugs nyusnyedang / dka' thub thams cad ston kyang sems can gzhan dang gzhan la ma mos pa dag gis brtul zhugs dang /dka' thub gzhan dang 19gzhan du mi mthong ste/ gzhan du na zhu gci 'dra ba'i brtul 21zhugs dang / dka' 22thub ci 'dra ba dag gis sems can nusnyede dag 'dul bar 'gyur ba de 'dra ba'i brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub mthong ba ni ma gtogs so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de la byang chub sems dpa' ni thams cad du ci byu 39wa 404

kha na ma tho ba med pa'i btang snyoms can yang yin la bya ba de dag kyang 1)kun tu ston te/ dka' ba spyod 5pa 'dis lha dang mi bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi theg pa gsum po dag la yongs su smin par byas so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros lha dang / mi gang dag rgya chen po la mos pa yongs su sbyong ba byas pa de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa na 'dug cing rimakha' khyab kyi bsam gtan la bsam gtan byed pa dang / mi g.yo ba dang / bde ba myong4)ba dang /lo drug lon nas byang chub sems dpa' 5ting nge 'dzin de las langs par mthong ngo ske/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de la lha dang mi chos can chos 'dod pa chos bstanate nopas yongs su smin par bya ba gang rtso)yin pa de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' las gzhan mi byed par rgyun mi 'chad par chos ston par mthong ste/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po la sbyor ba/ ye shes chen po 8)yang dag par 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi tshul la 9'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /bya dka' ba'i ye shes la 'jug pa/ bdud dang pas kyi 7sgol ba thams cad 'dul ba zhes bya'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar lo drug tshang nas byang chub sems dpa' ji skad smos pa'i brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub de dag las langs te klung ne ran dza the na'i 'gram du song nas 'jig rten dang 'thun par khrus byas te/ lus gtsang mar byas nas klung ne ran dza42na nas byung ste 'dug par gyur to12/ /de na grong mi'i bu mo legs skyes ma zhes bya ba des pa stong gi 'o ma bskol nyinab sbrang rtsi dang bsres pa'i 'o thug khyer te byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ngo / /gzhan lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang ske/ dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci 33—405

dang ske/ sto 'phye chen po bye ba phrag drug cu yang rang rang gi zas thogs te 'khod nas so so nas tshig 'di skad du/ kye skyes bu dam pa bdag gi7bshos gsol cig /kye skyes bu dam pa bdagasngogegi bshos gsol cig cesasnyizer ro'u)/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de na 55)byang chub sems dpasachu)grong mi'i bu mo legs skyes ma lasnyesogs pa lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za bye ba phrag0)drug cu po de dag thams cad kyi kha zas de dag blangs nas thams cad zos kyang phan tshun ma mthong ngo / /lha'i bu re res kyang byang chub sems dpa'5nyebadag gi7bshos gsol te/ byang chub sems dpa'atshwanyebadag gi bshos gsol nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par7rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar shes so/ /de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpas77bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas par gyur te/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' zas len par sbyor ba dka' ba spyod pa yang dag 'phags zhes bya ba'o/rte/ /zas len pasnyisems can yongs su smin par byed pa dka' ba tsho/)spyod pa yang dag 'phags kyi le'u zhes bya ba 6 )ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' lus bkrus te lus stobs dang ldan par gyur nas zas zos te byang chub kyi du snying po ga la ba der5)song ngo / /de nyesong ba dang sa la spyod pa'i lha'i bus bzangasamustezhes bya bas sa la spyod pa'i lha'i bu thams cad la bos te smras pa/ sa 'dzin gang zhig mi g.yo mi bskyodamanyepa/ /sred pasadzastebasal cing 2 khong khro rab spangs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni shing drung 39wa 406

byon / /sa gzhi dag ni legs par brgyan par bya'o)/ /legs so zhes te sa la spyod rnamasashedaga'/ /stong gsum thams cad yongs su phyag dar byed/ /me tog sil ma bkram zhing spos mchog bdugs/ /spos chu dag gis sa gzhi chag chag btab/ /lag na gzhong thogs de bzhin phrengakhub thogs/ /gzhal med khang gnas de bzhin bar snang brgya/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas dga' / /de tshe me tog sna tshogs char dupo)phab/ /gling bzhi pa dag rnams na5yeskyong ba bzhiX/ /ji snyed pa dag thams cad 'khor bcas te/ /rnam par 'dren la mchod bsnyebya ba'i phyir/ /gser gyi dra bas stong gsum thams cad bkabasti / /stong gsum 'jig rten brgya byin rdzu 'phrul che/ /de dag byang chub sems dpa' mchod pa'i phyir/ /sum cu rtsa gsum rnam rgyal khang mdzes pa/ /de ltas stong gsum thams cad mdzes par brgyan/ /'thab bral lha rnams thams cad rab dga' ste/ /skyes bu mchog la yang dag mchod pa'i phyir/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams kyi stong gsum kun/ /nam mkha' be+e drur+ya yi nyunyedra bas bkab / /dga' ldan rab dang dga' ldan lha rnams kyang / /de dag mu tig dra bas brgyan pa byas/ /rgyan phreng hu de bzhin zla gam rnams kyang thogs(nye/ /mu tig sil ma'i char yang rab tu 'bebs/ /lha'i rgyal po rab tu 'phrul gyi bar/ /rab tu dga' nas 'dzam bu'itswachu gser gyi/ /dril bu'i dra ba 8gser gyi drar skyabacas dang nyunye/ /sgra snyan bcas pas stong gsum thams cad bkab(snye/ /thams cad don la mi 'jigs mchod pa'i phyir/ /dbang sgyur 3)dag gis lha yi rin po che / /rnam par dag cing gzim )brjid mtha' yas pazhunya/ /'od gsal dri med dra badza gegacig kyang sprul/ /klu dang dri za lto 'phye ri chen po dang / /lha min mkha' 39—407

lding mi'am ci kun gyis/ /rang rang gnas dang77bkod pa rnams kyis ni/ /'dod khams legs par brgyan nas mdzes par byas/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de nas stong gsum gyi dbang po tshangs pa 5chen po dbang sgyur 0zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la mngon du phyogs par mthong nas tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la smras pa ri/ grogs po dag shes par gyisasku5)shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po mnabs56)pa/ dam bcas pa chen po ma bor ba/ go cha sra ba mnabs 47 pa/ thugs yongs sumanyemi skyo ba/byang chub sems dpa'i 9)spyod parwa rmethams cad las hu1nges par byung btunye/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu byon 1lhapa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad la mnga' dbang brnyes nyu tshopa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po'i rjes su zhugasalge pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba thams cad la shin tu zhugs pa/ bdud kyi 1skulas kyi lam thams cad las nyu yang dag par 'das pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog hurtepa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ sems can thams cad la rab tu thar pa'i lam ston pa ded dpon chen por gyur pa/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par 19mdzad pa/ stong gsum na dpa' bo sum̐ )gcig pur gyur pa/ chos kyi sman thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pa/ sman pa'i rgyal po chen po/ rnam par grol ba'i thabs brnyes 1pa/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnye/ shes rab kyi 'od chen po gtong ba tog chen po'i rgyal pori —snye/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis ma gos pa pad+ma chen po lta bu/ chos thams cad kyi gegazungs ma bsnyel ba du gergya mtsho chen po 39wa 408

dang 'dra ba/ rjes su chagasaphanyu1pa dang / khong khro ba dang bral ba/ mi g.yo ba/mi bskyod pa/ ri rab chen po lta bu/ shin tu dri ma med pa/ shin tu yongs su dag pa/ shin tu dkar ba'i blo dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po che chen po dang 'dra bal/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur khub/ sems las su rung ba/tshangs pa chen po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' de bdud kyi sde rab tu gdul5geb dang ske/ bla na med pa yang dag paralo5ri mngon par 6)rdzogs par byang chub par bzhed pa dang / stobs bcu 3)dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 6)brgyad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba dang / seng ge'i sgra chen po bsgrag / snapa dang / chos kyi sbyinatshwanyepas sems can thams cad tshim par hu mdzad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi mig rnam par sbyangatshwa ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad chos dang 'thun pas mitshar gcad 3nyepa dang / sngon dam bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bstan par bzhed pa dang /chos thams cad7la dbang phyug gi mnga' dbang brnyes 3 par mdzadamu pa'i phyir byang chub kyi snying por bzhud kyis3tshe/ de la grogs po dag khyed byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba la 6 rikhro bar gyis 21shig /de nas stong gsum gyir+sānyebadag po tshangs pa chen po mi mjed kyi bdag po de yid rab tu dga' nas tshangs ris du nyekyi lha thams cad la smras pa/ grogs sri po dag bskal pa brgya tsho snyestong mang por brtul zhugs dang dka' thub bsags pa/ skyes bu chen po dam pa desabyang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der bzhud kyis tsho/ de la khyed 2 kyis bkod pa chen po rnams kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po thams cad brgyan par gyisatsha 6shig /39wa 409

de nas tshangs pa chen po mi mjed kyi bdag posanyede'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sems can rnam dag brtul zhugasarkyuchos nges pa/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten dag la phan bzhed pa/ /lha dang mi yisalgemachod pa lha yi lha/ /thub pa chen po byang chub snying por gshegs/ /sdesadang bcas pa'i bdud ni gdul ba dang / /thams cad mkhyen gyi ⑤yi shes 'tshang rgyashedang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rnams ri nayongs bkang shedang / /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor7ba dang ske/ /mkhas pa seng ge'i sgra chen bsgrags pa dang / /sems can thams cad tshim par bya ba dang / /dam pa'i chos mig yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir/ /'dren pa byang chub snying por nye bar gshegs/ /phas kyi rgol ba rnams ni tshar gcad (nyadang ske/ /sngon gyi dam bcas yongs su bkang〈rteb dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /'dren pa byang chub snying por nye bar gshegs/ /legs par thams cad lhan cig 'dus hurtenas nirdzi/ /sa yi gzhi ni legs par brgyan par bya/ /stong gsum brgyan par gyur la ltos shig kye/ /'dod pa'i khams kyang brgyan par gyur pa sna 7ltos/ /'dod pa'i khams ni ji ltar brgyan pa bzhin / /de ltar gzugs kyi khams kyang brgyan par bya/ /tshangs pa rnams ni sems dang legs so zhes/ /rab tu dga' nas stong gsum brgyan par gyurahunye/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i khams natshwa/bkod snang ba/ /de bas lhag pa'i mchod pa5) de dag bstan/ /me tog rnams kyis bkang zhing spos kyis tebakang / /rin chen rnams kyis mchod cing sil snyan bsgrags/ /tshangs pa la du )sogs 'og min lha yi rnams / /rab tu dga' nas stong gsum thams cad kyang / /dga' bar 'gyur 2snyedang phyag bya'i 'os su byas/ /rang rang gnas kyi gzhi yang bkod pa byas/ /lha 39—410

rnams kyis ni gong nas gong du yang / /lhag pa lhag pa'i rgyan rnams rab tu bstan/ /lha yi bu mo bye ba drug cu brgyas/ /byang chub rdo rje gdan ni rgyanamanyu)par byed / /spos chu yis ni kun tu chag chag 'debs/ /me tog sna tshogs dag kyang 'thor bar byed/ /sa gzhi dag la57rin chen rnams kyang bkram/ /byang chub snying por rgyan⑧rnams rab tu bstan/ /thams cad tshig gis brjod par mi nus pa/ /de snyed tshad kyi bkod pa ngu'adir byas gyur/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' de byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba na stong gi dbang po tshangs pa chen po mi mjed kyi bdag pos tshangs7ris kyi lha thams cad la smras pa(6)/ grogs po dag bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang por brtul zhugs dang / dka' ( dzhathub rnams kyi spyod pa spyad pa sems can gyi mchog skyes bu chen po 'di58)byang chub kyi7snying por bzhud kyis7/ — de la khyed kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bkod pa chen po rnams kyis brgyan par gyis51shig /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas tshangs ris 32kyi lha'i bu rnams la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sems can rnam dag brtul zhugs chos des btso/ /phan bzhed 'jig rten don mdzad bdag nyid che/ /de ni blo ngan sder bcas bdud 'dul du/ /shing gi dbang po byang chub drung du bzhud/ /thams cad 'dus te lhan cig 'dong bar bya/ /stong gsum mi mjed 'di ni77brgyan par byas/ /'di ni lhar bcas 'jig rten chos kyi dbang / /yang dag mchod na bsod nams mtha' yas 'gyuratso/ /tshangs pa de dag hu tshotshig mchog de thos nas / /stong gsum thams cad ma lus rgyan 13byed cing / /legs par phyags te 3)me tog rgyal mtshan brgyan/ /'jig rten khams ni rin chen rang bzhin 39—411

sprul / /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od kyi bkod pa dang / /bye ba'i gdugs rnams nam mkhar de dag sprul/ /sā 1la'i shing rnams me togane mchog sprasate pa/ /dga' tshal lta bu de dag rnams kyis kyisprul/ /lam gang nas ni drang srong tsheporigashegs pa / /de ni shing rta bdun bstamasar kyitshad du sprul/ /rin chen gzhi 7)la gser gyi pad+ma bkram/ /kha khyer rim pa bdun gyis yongs su bskor45ri/ /brgya byin gyis der bkod pa gang byas pa/ /de dag lha mi rnams kyis 9)sngon ma mthong / /sum cu gsum dbang rnam rgyal khang 'dra bar/ /de ltar gling bzhi dag ni mdzes par brgyan / /'thab bral lha dang dga' ldan 'phrul ba 3 tshodang / /gzhan 'phrul ba dang 1 'og min lha yi 12rnams/ /stobs dang shugs 'chang thams cad brtson par ni/ /byang chub snying po dam nyugepa rgyan bipar byed/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i bar der ni/ /'dod pa'i khams 'dir dkonamatshamachog gang yod pa / /lha 'am klu 'am mi 'am ci rnams kyi/ /de dag thams cad skad cig de la bstan / /phyogs bzhi dag nas tshalha mo /tsho bye ba lhags/ /me tog 1snyernams dang spos dang byug pa yis/ /byang chub shing ni mngon du rgyan 39par byed/ /spos chu yis ni kun tu chag chag 3 ri'adebs/ /byang chub shing ni legs 37par brgyan byas te / /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi yongs 'du 'dra/ /lha rnams bye ba dag gis mdzes sprul pa/ /bkod pa de dag tshig gis brjod mi nus/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba na rkang pa'i mthil 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa gnyis las 'di 'dra ba'i 'od phyung 32ste 'od 2 des sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal 2stegyi tshor ba rnams rgyun bcad du gedo/ /klu'i 39—412

rgyal po nag po'i gnas kyang snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur nyuto/ /de nas klu'i bdag po nag pos byang chub sems dpa'i 'od mthong nas tshim zhing mgu la yi (5rangs te/ rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te thams cad dang ldan pa'i rang gi 'khor las /tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba'i 'od/ /gnas 'dir lhang gi nger gyur pas na/ /kho bo'i lus ni cirarab tu tshim/ /sems kyang rab tu dga' bar gyur6/ /kho bos sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /ltas bzang mthong ba ltar na ni/ /gdon mi za bar dpa' chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byung bar 'gyur/ /legs par phye ma phreng 7rib dang / / spos dang me togasho'u byug pa dang / /gser dang nor bu mu tig dang / /dung dang rgyan phreng 1sgomachog rnams dang / /rol mo sil snyan rnamasate/ tshothogs la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas ni/ /ba dan dag kyang bsgreng byas 31te/ /ston pa la ni mchod par bya12/ /klu yi rgyal po'i gnas 'di na1lha/ /bzang po'i rgyanangasarnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rab tu dga' ba yis/ /sangs rgyas la ni rim gro77bya/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po nag po chung ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ gnyen gyis 'khor dang bcas te/ me tog dang / spos dang / phreng nyu ba dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan thogs pa dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang / rol mo'i sgra 'byin pa rnams 39dang lhan cig tu rang gi gnas nas byung ste spos chus gang ba'i sprin mngon par sprul nas spos chu'i char pa ni 'bebs/ klu'i mu tig 2 dang / klu'i me tog du rtegi char ni 'bebs shing / klu'i mthu chen po dang / klu'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song ste phyin nas 'khor dang 39—413

bcas pas 1byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa byas te zhabs lashephyag 'tshal nas / rol mo dang / sil snyan len pa dang / bcas pas byang chub sems dpa' la bskor ri ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mngon par bstodasnyido/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ skyes bu mchog gi5nye'od nisnyirab bkye7bas/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'dis42thams cad snang bar gyur49)/ /skad cig de la ngan song gsum yang zhi/ /nag po'i gnas kyang 'od kyis khyab par gyur/ /klu yi rgyal po de yis 'od mthong nas/ /rab tu dga' ste de tshe tshig smras pa/ /gser gyi mdog gi 'od 'di byung lags na'o/ /de ring sangs rgyas5)'byung du gdon mi za / /klu mo khrag khrig dag gis mdun bdar te/ /gdugs dang me tog gos mchog thogs nas su/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni ga lar song / /phyag byas mchod pa byas nas gus bcas 'dug /sa 7kun rin chen me tog rnams kyis gang zhing de tshe mdzes par brgyan/ /shing mchog kun dang sman dang rtswasngorternams de dag byang chub shing la 'dudage/ /'di na yod pa'i7chu klung thams cad mi 'bab 1snyomakha' la rlung mi ldang / /de ring bdud btul nas ni 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum na brgya byin tshangs pa nyi ma zla ba'i 'od mi snang / /mtshungs med khyod kyi 'od kyis rig nas de ring ngan song gsum po zhi/ /bdag gi sna tshoganas su 'od byung nas ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba 18ston par bgyid/9/ /de ring rgyal ba du )byon par 'gyur gyis527dgyes mdzod rangs ru shing tshim pa skyedardusnye/ /bum pa gang ba 'di dag nam mkhar song ste khyod la skor 2geb dang / /tsa'i gesha'i tshogs rnamasam lha'adi dgamanyenam mkhar song ste khyed 28la skor sa ba dang / /lhar bcas mir bcas 'jig rten dag kyang mchod 39wa 414

par brtson par gnas pa las1)/ /de ring 'gro ba'i sbyin gnas 'gyur zhing shes rab 'dod pa'i lam du 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdags gis rnyed pa legs rnyedakhugazi brjid che 4)ldan pa/ /mi mchog 'khor ba 'jig dang de bzhin gser thub ces57ni bya ba mchod/ /mi mchog 'od srungamachi6)dang ni shākya rtso)mchog khyod de ring bdag gis mchod/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas dpa' mthong ma bral byang chub dam pa don du gnyer/ /sa ni grum zhing ririn ri rnams g.yos la 'gro 1)ba thams cad med 'gyur hu )srid/ /su zhig byang chub tu ni sems nges lhag pa'i bsam pas 'phags gyur pa/ /de ni de ring stobs bcu ldan par mi 31'gyur gnas ni mchis ma lags/ /seng ge'i sgra bsgrags tshangs pa'i dbyangs can bcom ldan 'dren pa gsung phyung shiganyushrī /zhi ba'i blo gros de nas klu'i rgyal po nag po'i chung ma dam pa gser 'od ces bya ba de klu'i bu mo rab tu mang pos bskor cing mdun du bdar nas gdugs sna tshogs thogs pa dang / ras bcos bu sna tshogs thogs pa dang / mu tig gi rgyan phreng 3 sna tshogs thuthogs pa dang /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs thogs pa dang / lha'i tshadang mi'i phreng tshab brgyus pa thogs pa dang / pog por hu 7sna tshogs thogs pa dang / sil snyan dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs len pa rnams dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i 18me tog sna tshogs kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'ong ba la 'thoram16zhing tshigs su bcad pa 'di ( 3 dag gis mngon par bstod tsho rmido/ /'khrul pa mi mnga' mi dngang sa mi bsnyengs 3lhebag mi〈 stetsha/ /ma ri snyezhum mi dman rab dgyes mi thub 5chags mi mnga' 1/ /sdang dang rmongs dang brkam pa mi mnga' chags 52bral ba 'o/ /rnam grol drang srong chen po khyodamatsha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dogs bral zug rngu bral zhing dul la ma rig sel/ /39—415

'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal rnams las rab tu 'grel/ /gnas dang skyabs dang gling ma mchis pa mkhyen nas ni/ /gnas khyod skyabs khyod 'jig rten gsum po dag tu byung / /ji ltar lha yi nyamatshogs rnams dad cing rab dga' ste/ /mkha' las me tog char chen rab tu 'bebs pa dang / /ji ltar gos chen dag kyang 'dor bar ribagyid lags na/ /drang srong chen po mgon po rgyal bar derasnye'agyur snyam/ /dgyes skyed ring)shing dbang drung gshegs mi bsnyengs rige)bzhugs mdzod la/ /bdud sde pham par mdzod4)de nyon mongs dra ba drol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal dbang de dag sangs rgyas pa/ /de ltar byang chub rab mchog zhi ba 'tshang rgyar mdzod/ /gang gi don ri du khyodamadukyis bskal pa bye mang du/ /'gro ba kyidag ni 1 dgrol phyir dka'atshwa ba rnams kyang spyad/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa de rdzogs shing dbang drung gshegs te/ /byang chub mchog la reg par mdzad pa'i dus 'di nyartelags // //bam po drug pa lha/ zhi ba'i blo gros de nas byang chub sems dpa' klu'i rgyal po nag po'i gnas nas 'byung nas byang chub 7kyi pasnying po ga la ba der song ste 'gro ba na lam gyi 1 g.yas rol na rtswa 'tshong 1snyebakra shis pa zhes bya ba rtswa brnga (6zhing 'dug pa des byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la mngon du phyogs pa mthong ste/ lha rnams kyis bskul nas rtswa ji 1'jam pa/ shin tu gzhon pa/nyams dga' ba/na yid 32dga' bar byed pa/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu dga' ba 'khyil pa na / g.yas su 'khyil pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa snye/ dri dang ldan pag ji / ka tsa yin di ka ltar reg na bde ba spar gang blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / rtswa ri 8spar gang byang chub 39wa 416

sems dpa' la byin te/ bsam pa thag pa nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros khyod rtswa 'tshong 11bkra shis pa mi snga mi 'phyi bar 95byang chub tu sems bskyedal cing rtswa yang byin no snyam du sems na de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni rtswa 'tshongamacho47bkra shis pa'i sngon gyi smon lam yin te / ji ltar kho bo bskal 6)pa bzang po pa'i 7)byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi snying por khri shom rin)pa bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhi ba'i blo gros kho bos mngon par shes te/ 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa bzang po 'di'i snga rol bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur59)ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/de'i gsung rab la dge slong stong tham 3 pa tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas bcom ldan 'das des khyed cag bskal pa bzang po la bla na med pa yang dag 11par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 12mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de dag lung bstan (rteto/ /de'i tshe na khyim bdag blo gros boldan zhes bya ba zhig 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur mate 'dug pa des/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag lung bstan pa de thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par 7rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed deyi tsho/ 'di skad du bskal pa bzang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba na seng ge'i khri byi dor bya'o/ /zhes smon lam btab po/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag blo gros ldan 39—417

zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan7zhig yin pa7snyam du khyod dogs shingasathe tshom za ba'am —sku / yid gnyis su gyur na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rtswa 5'tshong bkra shis pa 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag blo gros ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros khyod kyis rnam grangs 'dis kyang rtswa rjo'atshong bkra shis pa'i sngon gyi smon lam 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ sems can rnams kyi 8)mos pa ji lta ba dang / dbang po yongs su smin pa ji lta bu7bzhin du de kha cig la ni rtswa spar gang 'bul bar 'gyur/ kha cig la ni rin po che bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri 'bul bar 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po'i shing drung du song ba dang / byang chub kyi snying po'i lha rnams lha'i bu mo me tog gi skon bu thogs pa dang / spos dang phye ma'i phur ma thogs pa khri dang lhan cig tu byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ji ltar thogs pa'i me tog dang / phye ma dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' la gtor te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /bdag nyid chen po mi bsnyengs〈nyedapa' zhing dul zhi brka/ /dgyes shing tshim pa brtan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bar ba nyams dgyes kha na ma tho mi mnga' ba/ /skyon las grol ba'i hunyeston pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /sdug bsngal chen por bying ba mgon med 'gro 'di la/ /khyodasani bde ba rab tu stsol skoba'i mgon po gcig /'gro ba'i nyon mongs nad rnams spang ba'i phyir byung tshab/ /sman pa'i rgyal chen grags ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar lha tshogs dad cing rab tu dga' ba yis/ /lha yi me tog char pa rab tu 39—418

'bebs pa las/ / bdud dgashesde dang bcas pa byams pas bcom nas ni/ /khyod kyis byang chub dam pa ②de ring brnyes su nges/ /shing dbang drung du gshegs te khri der bzhugs nas su/ /bdud btul nas ni mun pa thams cad gzhom par mdzod/ /ji ltar sngon gyi thub dbang de dag sangs rgyas pa/ /de ltar byang chub zhi ba mchog rab 'tshang rgyar mdzod/ /ji ltar khyod kyis 'gro ba dgrol ①ba'i don du ni/ /bskal snipa bye bar dka' 3)mdzad rnam par dag 'gyur ba/ /drang srong chen po khyod kyi dgongs mchog deng rdzogs kyis4)/ /shing dbang drung du bzhugs te byang chub 'tshang rgyar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de nas byang chub sems dpas 47spar gang khyer nas byang chub kyi snying po ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / byang chub kyi shing drung du bdag nyid kyis rtswa'isnyigading ba btingashenas byang chub kyi shing la phyag 'tshal te lan bdun bskor ba byas so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' rtswa'i 3tegading ba bting〈shem thag tu de nas lha'i bu brgyad khri bzhi stong gis seng ge'i khri sna tshogs blta na sdug pa/ mtho ba/yangs pa/ rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa/ rin po che'i kha khyer〈nyecan/rin po che'i dra bsalgegayogs pa/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yer ma'iphagedra bsgo bres pa / mu tig gi rgyan phreng nyerab tu spyangs 3nyepa ras bcos bu77brgya stong du ma bting ba brgyad khri bzhi stong byang chub sems dpa'i ched du bshams so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de nasngo 3 byang chub sems dpa'apha1seng ge'i khri brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag thams cad la bdag nyid 'dug par zhu kun tu bstan par gyur to/ /lha'i bu de dag gis kyang gzhan dang gzhan du mi mthong mi shes te/ lha'i bu re res kyang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag gi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /39wa 419

bdag gi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar shes te/ de dag dga' ba dang ske/ mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /byang chub kyi snying por bzhud (17pa'i le'u zhes bya ba naste bcu gnyis pa'o// //zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i khri de la 'dug ma thag tu de nas smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i bar nas bdud bskul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od phyung 45)ste 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na 'khod pa'i bdud bye ba 4phrag bzhi brgya la reg go/ /'od des de dag la reg ma thag tu rang rang gi gnas na 'khod bzhin du spu zing zhes byed de/ rang gi bdud kyi gnas tshig cing mog mog por gyur par shes nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gang gi phyir gnas 'di dag mog mog por gyur par snang ba 'di la rgyu ni 5ci zhig yod rkyen ni 6ci zhig yod/ byang chub sems dpa' 'ams 7)cig byang chub kyi snying por 'dug nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur grang snyam ste/ rnam par bltas pa dang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug par mthong ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can de dag rang rang gi gnas nas mi snang bar gyur nas bdud re re yang gnod sbyin kha dog rnam pa mang po dang / cha byad rnam pa mang po dang / dbyibs rnam pa mang po dang / chu zheng rnam pa mang po dang / g.yo ba rnam pa mang po dang /mgo rnam pa mang po dang / mtshon cha rnam pa mang po dang / rgyal mtshan rnam pa 39—420

mang po thogs pa bye ba khrag ga1khrig brgya stong dag gis bskor te/ smra ba rnam pa mang po chosasmra zhing bdud kyi mthu chen po dang / bdud kyi rdzu 'phrul chen pos bdud re res kyang bdud kyi 'khor gyis rgyar dpag tshad nyi khri nyi khri ste/ khor 5yug tu dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong bkang nas byang chub kyi shing drung du dong ngo ske/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'khor chen po de dag dong ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe yid du mi 'ong ba/ mnyan par mi 'os pa/ mi snyan pa/ u dug ces bya ba dang /pi tsigasangaces bya ba dang / hu lu hu lu zhes bya ba dang / rgyob shig /zung shig(ge /sod cig /chings 6)shig ces bya ba'i sgra chen po de lta bu phyung bar gyur 7to / /gal te 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i sems can rnams kyis nasgra de 9thos 1 la / zhi ba'i blo gros gal te byang chub sems dpas sgra de mi grag 11par ma byas na ni de dag kha nas khrag dron po nyi skyug cing 'chi ba'am/ shi la 1 thug tsho1 pa'i sdug bsngal chen po arnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de tshani byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen pos non pas sems can la rnam par 'tshe bar 'gyur du 'ong ngo nyi zhes sgra de mi grag 12par byas par gyur to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i thabs la kyi mkhas pa'i yul yin no/ /zhi ba'i blo gros sgra de lta bu de thos kyang byang chub sems dpa' ni tha na spu g.yos par yang ma gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgra 'di ni1thams cad brag cha 22dang mtshungs par legs par rtogs pa'i phyir ro / /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub kyi 3 bsnyen bkur ba'i lha rnams kyis bdud lhags par rigs gnas bdud sdig can de dag la bzlog 27pa rnam pa bcu drug gis zlog gi par byed de/ sdig can dag phongs par 'gyur ba gdon 58par dka' ba rnam pa 'di lta bu 29'di dag gis ci zhig byas thong shig /de ci'i 39—421

phyir zhe na/ sdig can khyed ni gyad stobs chung7ngu la gyad stobs chen po bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas ldebardabs par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed lgeni dpa' bo chen pos pha rol gyi sde bcom pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas pham par gebyas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni srin bu me khyer la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas zil gyis non par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni phub ma spar gang la rlung mar bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas gtor bar 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyedasani shing sā59la chen po rtsa bamachi rinas chad pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas sgyelasabar 'gyur rol/ /sdig can khyed ni ri dgas kyi tshogs la seng ge bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas dngangs phyo par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni ba rjes kyi chu la nyi tshan bab pa /1ltar do med byang chub sems dpas yongs su zad par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed hu ni mitshwanyemadza' ba'i grong khyer la rgyal po chen po bab pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas rlagasapar 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni mi g.yo gecan tsogasad par bya ba shor ba ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas 'bros par byed par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed rteni tshongatshwanyepa lam rgyags 19mang po mes tshig pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas mgomakye 'khor bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni chos kyi rgyal po rgyal srid nyams pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas mya ngan byed du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed 1ni khrung khrung rgan po 'dab ni ma bregs pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas sems khongs su na bcug par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni 'brog dgon par lam rgyags nachad pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas phongs par byas par 39—422

'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su gru zhig pa ltar do mod byang chub sems dpas smre sngags 'don du bcugashepar 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyed ni bsreg⑧pa'i bskal pas rtswa chadang nags tshal ltar do med byang chub sems dpas rnyis par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sdig can khyedakyini rdo ba la7rdo rje chen po bab pa ltar do med byang chub sems dpas7rnam par gtorasnyibar 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar byang chub kyi bsnyen bkur ba'i lha rnams kyis bzlog pa ⑨rnam pa bcu drug gis bdud sdig can rnams zlog par byed kyang bdud sdig can de dag phyir ma log5)go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bskalasngo pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / legs par sdomasapa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang /bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang /dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang ske/ byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / rig pa dang / rnam par grol ba yongs su sbyang ba byas pas lag pa yigayas pa 'jam zhing gzhon 8la shin tu gzhon pa migaser gyi kha dog ltar 'dug pa brkyang ste/ snying rje chen pos bskyod pa dang / sems can thams cad rab tu 8thar bar bya ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pas spyi bo nas bzung ste/ lus thams cad la byugs〈nyenas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon du byas te hu'edran pa dang rmo rildan zhing shes bzhin du sa chen po la brdabasam1so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpas dges chen po la 39—423

brdabs ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so1/ /kun tu rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul to/ /rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go/ /rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu rab tu ldeg go / / 'khrugs so/ /rab tu 'khrugs so/ /kun tu rab tu 'khrugs sol/ / 'ur 'ur ro/ /rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /③chem chem mo/ / rab tu chem chem mo/ dzikun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /nishar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho'o6)/ /nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho'o ske/ /lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho'o⑧/ /byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho'o/ /mtha' mtho 9rin dbus dma'o/ /dbus mtho na mtha' dma'o//zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar rnam pa drug dang / ltas chen po bcwa 1 7brgyad du sa g.yos pa chen po 'jig rten du byung sna bar gyur tonyurte/ /bdud sdig can rnams kyis kyang 'ur sgra dang / tug chem /stegyi sgra chen po dang / zung shig 8dang / rgyob cig 7pa dang / chings shig sna pa dang / sodasngo cig pa'i sgra thos so/ /bdud kyi 'khor gyis ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthus steng gi bar snang la 'di lta bu'i sgra 'di thos so/ /drang srong nang na drang srong mchog /'di ni mi 'jigs7)sbyin pa ste / /srog chags kun gyi skyabs yin gyis( )/ /'di la skyabs su 'gro bar gyis/ /zhi ba'i blo gros bdud kyi 'khor gyis sgra de thos pa dang / gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu khas bub 21tu sa la sgyel 22nas skyes bu chen po yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ zhes tshig de 2geskad tsho nasmras so/ /bdud sdig can lhag ma rnams ni dpung gi tshogs dang lhan cig tu 'bros par 'dod na 'bros ma nus nas de dag la snying brtse ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'adza 539—424

lus las 'od phyung 1)ba dang / 'od des de dag 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral te/ rang rang gi tshiganas su dong ngo / /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpasashebadud 'dul ba'i rnam par sprul pa 'di bstan pa na bdud kyi 'khor de las gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cus ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /lha'i bu sngon sbyang ba byas pas brgyad khri bzhi stong ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur geto/ /bdud btul phyi ba'i le'u zhes bya bsheste bcu gsum pa'o// //zhi ba'i blo gros de ltaramacho)lha dang mi kha cig gis ni de ltar bdud 'dul〈1ba tshad med pa dang ldan par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni bdud yong thams cad du ma 'ongs par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rtswa bobating ba la 'dug par shes so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i pad ma bkod pa'i seng ge'i khri la 'dug par mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' sa la 'dug par mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri la 'dug par mthong ngo /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing shing gi rgyal po tsho 1a shad thar mthong ngo / kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol du 12mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin can du mthong ngo / /lha 3lhedang mi kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing shing ta la lasrid tsam du mthong zhing seng 39—425

ge'i khri shing ta la 1phyed tsam du mthong ngodzan// /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing shing ta la bdun srid tsam du mthong zhing seng ge'i khri shing ta la phyed50dang gnyis kyi srid tsam du mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi shing dpag tshad brgyad khri 5bzhi stong pa'i ri bar du ri mthong zhing seng ge'i khri po)dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong bar mthong ngo / /lha dang mi kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' bdud7'dul bar mthong ngo / / kha cig gis ni bdud gcig mthong ngo / /tsokha cig gis ni bdud rgya chen por mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'joms pa hunyal rtse 3)bar mthong ngo / /kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i dkyil na0lhaganas shing nam mkha' la 'dug pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na 14seng ge'i khri la 'dug cing byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mthong ste/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni yul mtha' 8med pa yin te byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa 17na 'khod pa de dag gi yon tan gyi rgyu'i khyad par ni tshad med par snang ngo —/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'aphanyebyang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par 'dug pa dang / sngon 'thun par spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' grangs med dpag tu med pa dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med 18pa dag nas lhags te/ mi 'jigs pa'i sgra rjod 17cing shis nyapa'i sgra dang /bde ba'i sgra dang / kun dga' ba'i sgra dang / mgyogs pa'i sgra dang / myur ba'i sgra dang / legs pa'i sgra dang / don yod pa'i sgra dang / dpa' ba'i sgra dang ske/ skyes bu dam pa'i sgra dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sgra dang / rgyas pa'i sgra dang ske/ bkra shis pa'i sgra dang / mi gdung ba'i sgra dang / ma du 1zhum pa'i sgra 33—426

dang / sngon gyi bsam pa'i sgra dang / spong ba tu)don yod pa'i sgra dang / yid bde ba'i sgra dang / rdo rje ltar mkhregasar5)pa'i sgra dang / skyes bu dam pa rtsen pa'i50sgra dang / phan pa'i sgra dang / skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i sgra dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sgra dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sgra rjod debya/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa la 'dug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 5dbugs 'byin pa rnam pa sna tshogs brgya stong dag gis dbugs 'byin to/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed do/ /bstod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed do/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sngon legs par spyad pa ste/ des na7phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa la 'dug pa la dbugs rina'abyin cing mchod pa byed kyang byang chub sems dpa' de la yang rjes su chags pa med la bdud kyi sde la yang khong khro ba med do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba dang bral bas skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis 981shes par bya ba dang /blta bar bya bshedang / thob par bya ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba gang ci yang rung ste de nya tshothams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub brnyes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa dag gis phyag g.yas pa brkyang〈nyeste/ sku bom mnyel 1 tam zhes snyun gsol lo/ /mnyel bib mi mnga' bar byang chub bamasko/ rang byung du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub 39—427

bam / sgrib 1pa mi mnga' bar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub bamachi // mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub bamari / kun tu ye shes kyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub bamar/ spyod yul ma 'dres pa dang ldan nam / snying rje chen po'i 6go cha bgos sam/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs bsabs 7sam/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur naram zhes yongs su 'dri'o/ /de la sems can gang dag dbang po 9yongs su smin pa de dag gis ni bya51 )ba de shes so/ /sems can gang dag dbang po yongs su ma smin pa de dag gis ni bya ba de mi shes so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub brnyes pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa zhag bdun gyi bar du spyan mi 'dzums 11par chos kyi dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su bstar ro na/ /spyan mi 'dzums 1 par byang chub kyi shing la yang gzigs so/ /lha'i bu 1 stong yang de la mchod do/ /bstod mdo/ /phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha'i bu mo brgya stong dag kyang de la mchod pa byed do/ /bstod 7do/ /phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam mthong nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems kyang bskyed do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub brnyes pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi lhung bzed rnams thogs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du dong bar gyur 1 to/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rgyal po chen po rnam 18thos kyi bu ste rgyal po chen po 19bzhi po de 2 dag go/ /gling bzhi pa 21'di nas ji ltar dong ba de bzhin du gling bzhi pa 22bye ba phrag tsho ribargya nas rgyal po chen po 2 bye ba phrag 25bzhi brgya lhung bzed rnams thogs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du dong ngo 27/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de la de bzhin gshegs pas 2 lhung bzed bye ba 39—428

phrag bzhi brgya rnams bzhes tenya)/ bzhes nas kyang lhung bzed gcig tu 5byin gyis brlabs nas 5rgyal po chen po re re 45yang 'di snyam du de bzhin gshegs pas bdag gi lhung bzed bzhes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bdag gi lhung bzed du gsol lo snyam du sems te/ de dag dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur zhesato/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub brnyes nas tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po dang / gzhan yang lha'i bu drug khri de bzhin gshegs pa'i thog ma'i zhal zas thogs nas dong bar gyur te/ de dag ni sngon 'di skad du kyi bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la thog mar zhal zas dbul 77lo zhes smon lam btab par gyur pa dag go/ /de dag gis na de bzhin gshegs pa la thog mar zhal zas phul nas dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis 9)bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur tol/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par 'dug ste thams cad mkhyen pa ma thob 1 pa las byang chub brnyes pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor ba'i bar du sems can gyi don mdzad pa de ni rab tu mang gi/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying por song ba'i 17bar du ni de lta ma 12yin no/ /zhi ba'i blo gros khyod kyis rnam grangs 'dis kyang 32ji lta 'ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub la nye bar gyur pa de lta de ltar sems can tshad med pa'i don byed pa de ltar 1gshes par bya'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub brnyes nas tshangs pa gtsug phud 1zhecan zhes bya ba tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad 39wa 429

kyis0)bskor cing mdun du bdar te tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur50nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan bdun bskor ba byas te / bcom ldan 'das la ④chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir sems can chos kyi snod du gyur pa dag mchis te/de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos bstanadzagepa 'tshal bar 'gyur gyisasti/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas chos bstan du gsol / zhes gsol ba btab bo/ /de ni sngon gyi smon lam gyis gyur pa ste/gang gis cho8)rgyal po yul 'khor srung gi bur khas blangs nas bdag gis bskal pa bzang po pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub brnyes pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo skor 9bar bskul lo zhes smon lam btab pa yin no/ /zhi ba'i blo gros tshangs pa gtsug pud bocan nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la chos kyi 'khor lo skor 11bar gsol ba btab kyis (shegazhan dag gis ni ma yin no snyam du khyod sems na nya de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ji ltar tshangs pa gtsug pud r+shacan gyis 15gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du tshangs pa bye ba phrag bcus kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba btab par gyur to/ /brgya byin bye ba phrag bcu dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bcus kyang bcom ldan 'das la chos kyi 'khor lo skor 7bar gsol ba btab par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo skor tsho/ 7bar gnang ba de'i tshe tshangs pa gtsug pudamurnyacan gyis grong khyer bā ra ṇa sī nya drang srong lhung ba ri dgas kyi nags5 )su bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo 1seng ge'i khri 'phang du rtedu dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong yod pa/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dgedang ldan pa/ bkra ba/ blta〈nyen sdug pa/39—430

sa'i steng na 'dug pa bshams par gyur to/ /ji ltar tshangs pa gtsug pudas3)can gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i khri bshams par gyur pa de bzhin du tshangs pa bye ba phrag bcu dang / brgya byin bye ba phrag bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa bye ba phrag bcus kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri bkra ba/ blta5shen sdug pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchogasnyedang ldan pa/ bshams par gyur to/ /zhi ba'i57blo gros de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer chen po bā ra ṇa sī (sheg la ba dang / drang srong lhung ba ri dgas kyi nagasalgeg la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ seng ge'i khri de dag thams cad la bdag nyid bzhugs par kun tu bstan gto/ /de na 7re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /bdag gi77seng ge'i khri la bzhugs5tenas chos kyi 'khor lo skor 'ibar 'gyur bar shes te/ de〈nyedaga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba de nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri de la bzhugs ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu g.yos te snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 7yul mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yul mtha' yas pa'i ting nge 'dzin desal mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mnyam par gyur param gnas te lag mthil ltar gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can dmyal ba pa'am/dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa'am/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'am/ mi'am(me/39—431

lha'am / sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag 07thams cad de'i tshe bde ba dang ldan par gyur ten/ sems can gang la yang 'dod chags kyis gnod pa med cing zhe sdang gis ma yin/ gti mug gis ma yin teri / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis gnod pa med cing gcig la gcig pha ma tsam du 'du shes te (gebyams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la chos mnyan pa'i phyir phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med dpag tu med pa dag lhags par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'isnyi'ajig rten gyi khams na dbang che ba dbang che bar grags pa'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye 6)chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin par /ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das la chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ngo / /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na nabacom ldan 'das la chos nyan 9)pa dbang che ba 1 dbang che bar grags pa dag gis sa phyogs gang khyab par ma gyur pa de ni tha na skra'i rtse mo'i cha gzhag 11pa tsam yang med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor chen po de 'dus par mkhyen nas/ dran pa dang ldan zhing mkhyen bzhin du ting nge 12'dzin de las bzhengs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan thugs rje chen pos bskyod napas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ su 1 yang rung bas chos dang 'thun par 'jig rten du ma bskor ba'i chos kyi mi'akhor lo bskor to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 33—432

de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo de ni ci nas kyang 'khor 'dus pa'i sems can rnams rang rang gi0)rnam par rig pa bzhin du kun tu shes te sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi bsam pa tshim par bya ba'i phyir bskor to(ba/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis〈chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de'i tshe chos mnyan pa'i phyir phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med dpag tu med pa dag 'dus par gyur to/ /'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag kyang 'dus par gyur 8)to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de la gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung 'di skad du kau di rgya45)mig mi rtag go/ /zhes bka' stsal pa de la7sdug bsngal gyisamesgras 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig sdug bsngalashelo zhes thos so/ /bdag med pas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig bdag med pa'o zhes thos so/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig stong ngo zhes thos so/ /zhi bas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig zhi ba'o zhes thos so/ /dben pas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig dben pa'o zhes thos so/ /mi rtag pas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig mi rtag pa'o zhes thos so/ /gnas med pas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig gnas med pa'o zhes thos so/ /sgyu ma lta bus 'dul ba rnams kyis ni 1)mig sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes 0thos so/ /rmi 31lam lta bus 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig rmi lam lta bu'o zhes thos so/ /chu zla lta bus 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig chu zla lta bu'o zhes thos so/ /mig yor lta bus 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig mig yor lta bu'o zhes thos so/ /brag ca 12lta bus 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig brag carwa lta bu'o zhes thos so/ /de bzhin du stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa 7dang /39—433

ma skyes pa dang / skye ba med pas 'dul ba rnams kyis ni mig stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang7/ mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma byung bar thos so/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung bas 'dulartsonanab rnams kyis ni mig rten cing 'brel par 'byungasheba'o zhes thos so/ /mig la ji lta ba de〈gebazhin du yid kyi bar du yangaspobarten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o 6)zhes thos so/ /de bzhin du gzugs rnams dang / sgra rnams dang ske/ dri rnams dang / ro rnams dang / reg bya rnams dang / chos rnams stong ngo zhes thos so/ /kha cig gis ni phung po mi rtag pa dang / kha cig gis ni khams mi rtag par thos so/ /kha cig gis ni skye mched bdag med pa'o zhes thos sol/ /kha cig gis ni phung po mi rtag pa nyid du thos la khams la mi rtag pa nyid du ma yin no/ /kha cig gis ni khams la mi rtag pa nyid du thos la phung pokhumi rtag pa nyid du ma yin no/ /kha cig⑧ni sdug bsngal gyi sgras rnamalo7par grol lo/ /kha cig boni kun 'byung 31ba'i sgras rnam par grol lo/ /kha cigasngorteni 'gog pa'i sgras rnam par grol lo/ /kha cig 7/rteni lam gyi sgras7rnam par grol lo/ /kha cig gis ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni yang dag paratsospong ba'i gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i gtam du thos so / /kha cig gis ni dbang po'i gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni stobs kyi gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni byang chub kyi yan lag gi gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni lam gyi gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni zhi gnas kyi gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni 1 tsholhag mthong gi gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni brten /shepa'i gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni nyan thos dang rab tu ldan pa'i 39—434

gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas dang rab tu ①ldan pa'i gtam du thos so/ /kha cig gis ni theg pa chen po dang rab tu ldan pa'i gtam du thos te②/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi bsam pa tshim par bya ba'i phyir〈chos kyi 'khor lo bskor to/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sems can gyi don mdzad pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong shākyiri'i bus kyang sems can de dag bgrang ba'i rtogs pas/ lo brgya yang rtogs par mi nus na sems can gzhan dag gis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dka'aphub spyad pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / bdud 'dulasheb dang / bkod pa dang / seng ge'i sgra dang / rnam par rol pa dang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bstan pa 'di bshad pa na/ srog chags brgyadanyekhri bzhi stong gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyedahūdo/ /sems can tshad med pa dag ni theg pa gsum la yongs su smin7par byas so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de skad bstan pas de bzhin gshegs pa la skur7pa'am/ gcig tu ma gyur lags sam/ 'on te de bzhin gshegs pa bstan pa dang rjes su 'thun pa'am/ gcig tu lta'ang lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i0 bstan pa ni zab pa lags(ste/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni zab ste/ 'jig rten 39—435

thams cad dang mi 'thun pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs nges par dgongs pa ni zab pa lags te1)/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gang na bstan pa de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bdag gi (gulus la gnas pas 4lags kyi/ 'di bdag gi sa rtsal gyis ni ma lags par 'tshal tone/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba tsho pa'i bdag po de de bzhin no/ /2ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang su dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i 9rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir chos smra ba de dag thams cad kyi lus la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gsang ba pa'i bdag po gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de/ gang de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis ma brlabs71 par sems can de 31dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba smra ba'amanya / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid dang 'thun pa de ni gnas ma 1 yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis ma brlabs 1 pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba 7shes par ram/ mnyan par ram/kho bshad par nus pa su zhig yod/ gsang ba pa'itshwa tshobadag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid ni mchog tu yang dag pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid ni de kho na'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs pa ni yang dag pa'o zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyid yang dag par smra bas smra ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa gang yin pa de ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'dir bstan nya 39wa 436

to / /bsnyad do/ /ri1kyirab tu bshad do/ /gsang ba 2pa'i bdag po gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos pa dang yid ches par 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag kyang 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po ri 'i rgyal po ri rab ni mgo bos bsgyel ba 'am phrag pa pal thogs par nus kyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams kyis ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos par ram/ dad par ram/ yid ches par yang mi nus na(ba / blang bar ram/ kun chub par ram/6 kun chub par bya bar ram/gzung bar ram/ sbyor bar bya ba ༅lta smos 8)kyang ci dgos te/ de ni gnas ma yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa dang /mos pa'i sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas gcig la bsnyen bkur 99)byas pa ma yin pa nas sangs rgyas bcu la bsnyen 3 bkur byas pa ma yin gyi/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 37skyes bu dam pa 3)de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong hunamang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis brtan hu dpa dang ske/ theg pa chen po 'di la nges gepar byas par rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems can 8de dag ni sangs rgyas gcig la bsnyen bkur byas pa ma yin/ gnyis la ma yin/ gsum nyi la ma yin/ bzhi la ma yin/ lnga la ma yin / sangs rgyas bcu la bsnyen bkur byas pa ma yin gyi/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang /yongs su sbyang ba byas pa dang / theg 1 pa chen po 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon btab pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba'i blo gros kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nye bar zhi ba nye 33—437

bar zhi ba zhes bgyi ba la nye bar zhi ba zhes bgyi ba 'di ni gang lags/ gang nye bar zhi bas nye bar zhi ba zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 6)pa/rigs kyi bu nye bar zhi ba nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni nyon mongs pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas dun so/ /nyon mongs pa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni kun tu rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /kun tu rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtog pa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni 'du shes yid la byed pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /'du shes yid la byed pa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni phyin ci log nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /phyin ci log nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyusadang dmigs pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rgyu dang dmigs pa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni ma rig pa dang srid pa'i sred ④pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /ma rig pa dang / srid pa'i sredasnyipa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni ming dang gzugs nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /ming dang gzugs nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni chad pa dang / rtag par lta ba nye bar yezhi ba'i tshig bla dgas so/ /chad pa dang rtag par lta ba nye bar zhi ba zhes bya ba 'di ni 'jig57tshogs la lta ba nye bar zhi ba'i tshig bla dgas 8)so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar na dmigs pa dang /rgyu dang lta ba dang ldan pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa 'byung ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba las 'byung ngo57)/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba nye bar zhi na/ lta ba thams cad nye bar zhi'o( )/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba nye bar zhi 39—438

na smon pa thams cad nye bar zhi'o/ /'jig tshogs la lta ba nye bar zhi na/ nyon mongs pa thams cad nye bar zhi'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste dper na/ shing gi rtsa ba bcad na/ yal ga dang lo ma dang / yal ga phra'u0)thams cad skam par 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin dula'ajig tshogs la7lta ba nye bar zhi na nyon mongs pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su mi shes na nye bar len pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes par gyur na nye bar len pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa7thams cad mi 'byung ste/ gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su 'tshal ba ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/zhi ba'i blo gros bdag kun nas mi slong ba ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa'o / /sems can kun nas mi slong ba dang / srog dang gang zag tu lta ba kun nas mi slong ba ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa'oyi/ /zhi ba'i blo gros lta ba de ni nang na yang mi gnas/ phyi rol na yang mi gnas so/ /lta ba gnas pa med pa de la mi gnas par shes pa gang yin pa 'di ni/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa'o/ /zhisheba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi tshig bla dgas te'u)/ stong pa nyid kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pas 1)lta ba de mi 'dzin pa gang yin patshwari )'di yang zhi ba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa07med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / skye ba7)med pa'i lta bas 'jig tshogs zhes bya 39—439

ba'i lta ba de mi 'dzin pa 'di yang zhi ba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su shes pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'jig tshogs zhes bya ba de ni tshogs ma yin pa/'byung ba ma yin pa/ rnam par 'byung ba ma yin pa ste/ de ni gzod ma57nyid nas byung ba ma yin pa/ kun⑧brtags pa'o/ /byungasheb ma yin zhing kun brtags /pa gang yin pa de ni yongs su brtag57pa ma yin/ rnam par brtagashepa ma yin no/ /yongs su brtagamanyapa ma yin/ rnam par brtagashepa ma yin pa gang yin pa de ni bya ba ma yin pa/ rnam par bsgrub ri7pa ma yin pa/ bslang ba ma yin pa/ shes par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /bya ba ma yin pa dang / rnam par bsgrub pa ma yin pa dang / bslang ba ma yin pa dang / shes par bya ba ma yin pa gang yin pa 1 de ni zhi ba zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ nye bar zhi ba dang ldan pa/nye bar zhi ba dang ldan pa zhes bgyi ba/ gang nye bar zhi bas nye bar〈nyezhi ba dang ldan pa zhes bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ dmigs pas sems 'bar bar byed de/gang phyis dmigs par mi byed pa de/tsho mi 'bar ro/ /mi 'bar na nye bar zhi ba dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste dper na me ni rgyu las (/snye'abar gyi/ rgyu med na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dmigs pa las sems 'bar gyi/ dmigs pa med na zhi bar 'gyur ro// //1thubam po bdun pa/ zhi ba'i blo gros de la byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa nyugeshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa ni dmigs pa zhi ba nyid du yang rab tu shes la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la dmigs pa yang zhi bar mi byed do / /nyon mongs pa la dmigs pa 3 1yang mi skyed (snyel pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa 17yang skyed ni do/ /bdud dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dmigs pa 39wa 440

yang ༅spong la byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i ri chos la dmigs pa yang mi spong ngo / /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'dod pa la dmigs pa risayang mi len la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems la dmigs pa ri yang mi 'dor rol/ /stong pa nyid du dmigs pa 3)la yang rab tu rtog 6)la sems can thams cad snying rje chen po'i dmigs par yang blta'ortso)/ /zhi ba'i blo 48)gros de ltar byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa 7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa nitshaskyedamigs pa la dbang 'thob hu7ste/ ma skyes pa'i dmigs pa la yang nges par sems la bsams tsobazhin du skye ba'i dmigs pa yang mi spong ngo / /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i hu)dmigs pa la muyang 'jug la dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du bya ba'i (snyedamigs pa yang nyams 'og tu chud par byed do/ /mtshan ma med pa'i dmigs pa la yang dpyod tshal byang chub kyi sems kyi dmigs pa yang chud mi gzon 0to/ /smon pa med pa'i dmigs pa yang rnam par mthong la khams gsum pa'i dmigs pa lahwasnyeyang mi smod do/ /shes rab dang thabs las nges par byung ba de ni dmigs pa thams cad la yang nyi dbang byed par 'gyur (bye te de mi sdug pa la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sdug pa la sems gnas so/ /mi rtag pa la dmigs nas 'khor ba la sems yongs su zhunyami skyo ba nyid du semasadza rnyeganas so/ /sdug bsngal la dmigs nas sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa ri ci bde ba la 39dgod par sems gnas so/ /bdag med pa la dmigs nas/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems gnas so/ /'dod chags la dmigs nas 2gesems can 'dod chags la spyod pa rnams la du lhami sdug pa'i sman chen po yang dag par bstan par sems gnas so/ /39ge441

zhe sdang la dmigs nas sems can zhe snang la spyod pa rnams la byams pa chen po'i sman chen po yang dag par bstan par sems gnas so/ /gti mug la dmigs nas sems can gti mug la spyod pa rnams la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i sman chen po yang dag par bstan par sems gnas so/ /cha mnyam pa la dmigs nas sems can cha mnyam pa la spyod pa rnams la mi rtag pa'i 'du shes kyi tu)sman chen po yang dag par bstan par sems gnas so/ /'dod chags dang bral ba la dmigs nas nyan thos su 'dul bar sems gnas so/ /zhe sdang dang bral ba la dmigs nas rang sangs rgyas su 'dul bar sems gnas so/ /gti mug dang bral ba la dmigs nas byang chub sems dpar7'dul bar sems gnas so//gzugs la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs thob par bya bar sems gnas geso/ /sgra la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgra dbyangs thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /dri la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung thob par bya bar ring sems gnas so/ /ro la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan ro bro ba'i mchog thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /reg bya la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon pa thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /chos la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems nges par sems pa thob par bya bar sems gnas sol/ /sbyin pa la dmigs nas mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /tshul khrims la dmigs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar sems gnas so/ /bzod pa la dmigs nas tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs dang gser gyi mdog tu 'dug pa'i pagasasngogepa thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /39—442

brtson 'grus la dmigs nas sems can thams cad bsgral bar sems gnas so//bsam gtan la dmigs nas mngon par shes pa bskyed par sems gnas so/ /shes rab la dmigs nas sems can thams cad0)kyi lta ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i〈mikun nas nyon mongs pa rgyun bcad lgepar sems gnas so/ /byams pa la dmigs nas sems can thams cad la khong khro ba'i sems med par bya bar sems gnas so/ /snying rje la dmigs nas dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung bar sems gnas so/ /dga' ba la dmigs nas chos bstan pa la mchog tu dga' bar bya bar sems gnas so/ /btang snyoms la dmigs nas sems can rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba spang ba la sbyarapo)bar sems gnas so/ /bsdutuba'i dngos po la dmigs nas sems can yongs su smin par bya bar sems gnas so/ /ser sna'i skyon la dmigs nas bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtangashebar sems gnas so/ / 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi5bskyon la dmigs nas tshul khrims rnam par dag par bya bar sems gnas so/ /gnod sems kyi skyon la dmigs nas bzod pa'i stobs dang des padza'o)la sems gnas so/ /le lo'i skyon la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs yongs su bsgrub par sems gnas so / /g.yeng ba'i skyon la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ / 'chal pa'i shes rab kyi0)skyon la dmigs nas chags pa med pa'i ye shes rab tu rdzogs par bya bar 31sems gnas so/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas yid la byas nas theg pa chen posngo yang dag par bsgrub par semasam8gnas so/ /yid 'byung ba yid la bobyas nas sdig pa thams cad mi bya bar sems gnas so/ /ngan 'gro ngan song yid la byas nas ngan 'gro7tshe39—443

ngan song dang / mi khom par skyes pa'i sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab par sems gnas so/ /lha yid la byas nas 'byor pa thams cad mthar rgyad )1par 'gyur bar sems gnas so/ /mi yid la byas nas snying po blang bar sems gnas so/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran par yid la byas nas sangs rgyas dang phrad par bya bar sems gnas so/ /chos rjes su dran pa yid la byas nas slob dpon gyi chos la dpe mkhyud med par bya bar sems gnas so/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yid la byas nas 4phyir mi ldog pa'i chos thob par bya bar 3)sems gnas sol/ /gtong ba rjes su dran pa yid la byas nas gtang ri ba thams cad nayongs su gtang 8bar sems gnas so/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa yid la byas nas smon pa dang / bsam gtan dang / byang chub kyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs par bya bar sems gnas so/ /lha rjes su dran pa yid la byas nas/ lha thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la gnas par bya bar sems gnas so/ /lus yid la byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /ngag yid la byas nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung thob par bya bar 9tshosems gnas so/ /sems yid la byas nas 1 sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa'i sems thob par bya bar sems gnas so/ /'dus byas la dmigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya bar sems gnas so/ /'dus ma byas la dmigs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya bar sems gnas te/ zhi ba'i blo gros de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phyir yid la mi 11byed pa'i dmigs pa de gang yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de'i dmigs pa thams cad ni byang chub tu yongs su bsngos the 39wa 444

pa'o/ /chos thams cad byang chub kyi rjes su song bar mthong ba 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i thabs la mkhas pa ste/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste/ dper na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sa las skye ba ni skye ba ji lta bar stiskyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi ②yongs su spyad par mi 'gyur ba gang yangasamed do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub kyi phyir yongs su spyad pa dang / byang chub kyi phyir phan 'dogs rjopar mi mthong ba'i dmigs pa gang yang med do/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste/ dper na gzugs gang ci yang rung ste de thams cad ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi las gyur pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin du thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dmigs pa gang ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad ni byang chub kyi rnam pa dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros sems can gang dag 'jungs pa dang / byas pa mi gzo ba de dag57las byang chub sems dpa'i ⑧sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag khro〈ba lam7spyod pa dang /le lo can de dag las byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag glen pa dang / rmongs pa de dag las byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes 3terab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag phan mi 'dogs pa de dag las〈rtebyang chub sems dpa' khong khro ba'i sems su mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag phan 'dogs pa de dag larwanyebyang chub sems dpa' rjes su chags pa'i sems 39—445
