dang ske/ mnyen pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / rtag tu brtson pa dang /dkar po'i chos yongs su tshol ba la brtson pa mi 'dor bar gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du smon lam chen po yang dag par bsgrubs 31par gyur to//sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / slob dpon dang /mkhan po dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa dang bcas shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rtag tu go cha bgos te/ drang ba dang / mnyen pa dang /tshul 'chos pa med pa dang / kha gsag smyo med pa dang / yon tan dang ldan zhing sems can thams cad dge ba'i chos thams cad yang dag par 'dzin du bcug ②pa'i sngon du ni 'gro/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan pa ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /6) mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag 6)pa med pa'i gnas pas ni gnas rtso)te/ nga rgyal med cing ngag legs par bsrungs par gyur tor)/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na des ngag gi las 'byunga'atsho /ba gang bdag dang / gzhan dang / gnyis ka 3 la gnod par 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu spangs nas ngag gi 1nyalas gang 32bdag dang /gzhan dang / gnyis ka lha la phan par 'gyur ba de dag 〉brtson par gyur te/de ltar shes bzhin can du gyur cing grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal skodang ske/ yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams su 'jug pa na nam yang gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos la rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba med par gyur to/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i7spyad pa spyod pa na bdag nyid kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing gzhan yang de nyid yang dag par 'dzin du bcug go/ /bdag nyid kyang tshul 39wa 727

khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing gzhan yang de nyid yang dag par 'dzin du bcug go/ /gang dag dang ldan na ri17gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma sa las 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yang dag par bsgrubs par gyur to/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i smyo spyad pa spyod pa na sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa gang dag ngag gi las kyis mthar phyin par sla ba ma yin pa de snyed bla na med pa sa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bkod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa 'a kyide snyed la na bza' dang /zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang snyun gyi 5tshogasos sman dang / yo byad rnams dang ske/ bde ba las sbyar ba la 7reg par gnas pa thams cad kyis bste stang du byas / bla mar byas/ rim gror byas te namachod pa tsho byas so/ /sems can ji snyed rab tu smin 1 par byas pa dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang /blon po dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs shing sā nyu la chen po lta bu dag 12la rab tu dgod 1 pa de dag kyang tshig gis bstan pas mthar phyin par sla khib ma yin no/ /de bzhin du 15'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang phyug nyid dang /'khor los sgyur lab nyid dang / 'jig rten skyong ba nyid dang / brgya nya tshobyin nyid dang / rab 'thab 1 bral nyid dang / yongs su dga' ldan nyid dang /rab 'phrul dga' 19nyid dang / dbang sgyur 2 nyid dang / lha'i rgyal po nyid dang ske/ tshangs pa chen po nyid la rab tu bkod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa de snyed la bste stang du 21byas/ bla mar byas/39wa 728

rim gror byas te mchod nas chos kyi 'khor lo 17bskor bar bya ba'i phyir gsol ba btab pa de dag kyang ngag gi las kyis 45)bstan pas mthar phyin par sla 3ba ma yin no/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgyadzabastong dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med / gzhal du med/ tshad med/ brjod du med par kha nas lha'i las shin tu 'das pa'i tsan dan gyi sku)dri rab tu zhim pa'i bsung zhi'abyung ba dang / spu'i khung bu thams cad nas me tog ud pa la'i bsung 'byung ba dang / 'jig rten thams cad na gzugs bzang zhing mdzes la blta na sdug pa dang / kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos lus legs par brgyan pa dang / de'i rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang /gos dang / chos gos mngon par bsgrub pa thams cad dang / me tog dang /spos dang / bdug pa dang / phreng 7ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan 4zhesamangon par bsgrub pa thams cad dang / rol mo'i sgra dbyangs hā dang / glu 3 tshodabyangs mngon par bsgrub pa thams cad kyang spu'i khung bu thams cad dang 11/ lag pa gnyis nas 'byung ba dang / zas dang /skom 12dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / bldag pa dang / ro bro ba mngon par bsgrub pa thams cad dang / longs spyod dang / yongs su spyad pa mngon par bsgrub pa thams cad kyang lag pa gnyis nas zag cing 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnam pa de lta bu'i dge ba 1 yang dag par bsgrubs so/ /kun dga' bo de ltar dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas des 1 sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na yo byad thams cad la dbang ba'i pha rol tu son par gyur to/ /de 39wa 729

skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa 4)kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi 'byung gnas de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das lags sam/ 'on te mngon par rdzogs par sangs mdza rgyasam 9sam / 'on te da ltar byung ba na mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ da ltar 4)na bzhugs la 'tsho zhing gzhes 5te chos kyang ston/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa de ni 'das pa yang ma yin / ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas da lta na ⑥bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes 7la chos kyang ston te/ 'di nas nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong na 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ces bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa dag dang / nyan thos mtha' yas pa dag gis yongs su bskor cing na mdun du bdar te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas pa dang ldan no/ /de'i 'od ni dpag tu med de/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di snyed cig dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag 'di snyed cig dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag 'di snyed cig dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig dang /sangs rgyas 9kyi zhing bye ba phrag 'di snyed cig dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya phrag 'di snyed cig dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba stong phrag 'di snyed cig 39—730

dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig khyab par byas te 'dug go zhes mtha'i tshad rtogs par sla ba ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'on 1)kyang mdor bstan na(na/ shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i ③klung gi bye ma snyed dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de'i 'od kyis rtag tu khyab bo/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang /'og dang / steng dang / phyogs mtshams 4kyi phyogs re rer53)yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i 6klung gi bye ma snyed dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i 'od kyis rtag tu khyab ste/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyis 57)byin gyi rlabs 3kyis 'od 'dom gang ba dang / 'dom 9do pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang ske/ lnga pa dang / bcu pa dang / nyi shu pa dang / sum cu pa dang / bzhi bcu pa dang / lnga bcu pa dang / 'od dpag tshad bcu nya snapa dang / 'od dpag tshad brgya pa dang / 'od dpag tshad stong pa dang / 'od dpag tshad brgya stong pa nas 'od (1dpag tshad bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar du khyab par gyur te gnas pa ni ma gtogs 32so/ /kun dga' bo dpe gang gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i 'od kyi tshad gzung ba'i dpe gzhag pa med de/ kun dga' bo rnam grangs des na de bzhin gshegs pa de 1lha'od dpag med ces bya geste/ 'od dpag tu med pa dang / snang ba dpag tu med pa dang / 'od thug pa 5med pa dang /'od chags pa med pa dang / 'od thogs pa med pa dang / 'od rtag tu gtong 39—731

ba dang / lha'i nor bu'i 'od dang / thogs pa med pa'i 'od zer711gyi rgyal po'i 'od dang / chags par 'gyur ba'i 'od dang / dga' bar 'gyur ba'i 'od dang / mchog tu dga' bar 'gyur ba'i 'od dang / tshim par 'gyur ba'i 'od dang / lta bar 'gyur ba'i 'od dang / 'brel bar 'gyur ba'i 'od dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od dang / mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od dang / mi'i dbang po dang lha'i dbang po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'od dang / nyi ma dang zla ba zil gyis gnon cing namog mog por byed pa'i 'od dang / 'jig rten skyong ba 5dang la/ brgya la byin dang / tshangs pa dang / gnas gtsang ma pa 5dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / lha thams cad zil gyis gnon cing mog mog por byed pa'i 'od dang / mdor bsdu na 'od thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'ol/ /de'i 'od de ni dri ma med pa/ shin tu rgyas pa lus la bde ba skyed pa/sems dga' 6bar byed pa lha dang / lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang ske/ dri za dang / nam mkha' lding dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi'am ci dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams la dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / bde ba skyed 7pa/ sems can dge ba'i bsam pa can rnams la dge ba dang / yang ba dang / rtogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang / blo dang mchog tu dga' ba byed pa'o/ /kun dga' bo rnam grangs 'dis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan mtha' yas mu med pa dag de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su gang ste/bskal par de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i mtshan gyi las rgyur byas pa dang ske/ 'od phun sum tshogs pa las brtsams te brjod kyang mtshan bstan pa dang / 'od phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gyi mtha' yang rtogs par mi nus la/39—732

de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa yang rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de'i 'od kyi yon tan 'byor pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab dang /spobs pa bla na med pa dang / de gnyi ga 1)yang grangs med/ dpag tu med cing bsam gyis mi khyab la mu med pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dpag tu med de/ nyan thos bye ba phrag 2'di snyed cig ce'am na/ nyan thos bye ba brgya phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/nyan thos bye ba stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ nyan thos bye ba brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ gtams laphrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ dkrigs 5phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ khrag khrig phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ ther 'bum phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ mi 'khrugs pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ rnam 'deg nephrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ rgyun 'bab skyaphrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ rgyal ba phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ dpag tu med pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ grangs med pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bgrang du med pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/mtshungs pa med pa phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa phrag 'di snyed cig ces 8de'i tshad gzung bar sla ba ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na dge slong mod gal 9 gyi bu chen po rdzu 'phrul la dbang thob pa de 'dod na / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na skar ma'i gzugs ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad nyin zhag gcig gis bgrang 1 ba de lta bu'i rnam pa'i 1 rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yod par gyur la/ de dag las gzhan 1dmi byed par lo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 39wa 733

dpag med kyi nyan thos dang po 'dus pa bgrangs kyang de dag gis brgya'i char yang bgrangs par mi 'gyur te/ stong dang / brgya stong dang / cha dang /dpe dang / rgyu'i bar du yang bgrang bar71mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya rimatsho chen po zabs su dpag tshad brgyad55)khri bzhi stong yod pa/ khyon dpag tu med pa la mi la la zhig gis skra tshal pa brgyar gshagasasho ripa'i rtse mos chu'i 5thigs pa tshogacig blangs na kun dga' bo 'di ji snyam du semasal/ gang skra tshal 7)pa brgyar gshags 2)pa'i rtse mos chu'i 9)thigs pa gcig blangs pa dang / gang rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i phung po 1 riphyin las 11pa de gnyis gang mang / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpag tshad stong yang rgya mtsho chen po bas nyung lags na/ skra tshal pa brgyar gshags 32pa'i rtse mos chab thigs pa gcig 1lhablangs pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal3ci/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / kun dga' bo chu 5thigs pa gcig lta bur ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi nyan thos dang por 'dus pa la mod gal77gyi bu lta 1 bu'i dge slong rnams kyis lo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du bgrangs te 'di snyed cig go zhes grangs kyis chod pa lta bu yin no/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i phung po phyin las 1 pa lta bu ni 19glangs kyis ma chod par blta bsto riyin na nyan thos 'dus pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni de ltar mtha' yas mu med de/ de ni dpag tu med do zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba yin no/ /kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i tshe'i tshad kyang 31dpag tu med de/bskal 2pa 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bskal 3 pa brgya phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/39—734

bskal7)pa stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bskalas pa brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bskal pa bye ba phrag la 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bskal45)pa bye ba brgya phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/ bskal 6pa bye ba stong phrag 'di snyed cig ce'am/bskalashepa bye ba brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig ces bya ba nas bskal 8pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'di snyed cig go zhes bya ba'i bar du 9tshe'i tshad rtogs par sla ba ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i sku tshe'i tshad de ltar dpag tu med de/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de tshe 7dpag med ces bya'o/ /kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 11byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ji ltar da ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na bskal 12pa'i grangs dang / bskal pa'i bgrang ba'i 1lhabardar btagasalgepa de lta bu'i bskal 15pa bcu lon no/ /kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi 'jig rten gyi sakhams bde ba can zhes bya ba ni 'byor bas mod pa/ bde ba 18lo legs pa/ nyams dga' ba/ lha dang mi mang pos gang ba'o/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams de na sems can dmyal ba med do / /dud 'gro'i skye 19gnas med do/ / yi dgas 2 kyi yul med do/ /lha ma yin gyi ris med do/ /mi khom par skye ba med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na snang ba'i rin po che gang yin pa de dag ni 'jig rten na mi spyod do/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de ni spos sna tshogs dri rab tu zhim pa'i sdo 1ngad ldang ba'o na/ /me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs 'byor pa'o/ /rin po che'i shing ljon pas legs par brgyan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 5 39—735

sprul pa'i bya rnam pa 3sna tshogs sgra yid du 'ong ba can gyi tshogs kyis sten5lde)pa'o/ /kun dga' bo rin po che'i shing ljon pa de dag ni kha dog tha dad pa/ kha dog du ma pa / kha dog brgya stong phrag du ma yod pa'o/ /kun dga' bo de na ril/rin po che'i shing ljon pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang / gser gyi rang bzhinamunadag yod dol/ /dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dang dngul gyi rang bzhin dag yod do/ /be+e drur+ya'i kha dog lta bu dang be+e dūr+ya'i rang 6bzhin dag yod do/ /shel gyi kha dog lta bu dang shel gyi rang bzhin dag yod do/ /spug gi kha dog lta bu dang spug gi rang bzhin dag yod do/ /mu tig dmar po'i kha dog lta bu dang mu tig dmar 7po'i rang bzhin dag yod do/ /rdo'i snying po'i kha dog lta bu dang rdo'i snying po'i 8rang bzhin 9dag yod do/ /kha cig ni gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che sna gnyis pa dag yod do/ /gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang /rin po che sna gsum pa dag kyang yod do/ /gser dang / dngul dang / bai drur+ya dang / shel dang / rin po che sna bzhi pa dag 1 kyang yod do/ /gser dang ske/ dngul dang / bai dūr+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang / rin po che sna lnga pa dag kyang yod do/ /gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang /shel dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po dang / rin po che sna drug pa dag kyang yod do/ /gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang /spug dang / mu tig dmar po dang / rdo'i snying po dang / rin po che sna bdun pa dag kyang yod do/ /kun dga' bo de na gser gyi shing 11ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab 'am dang /me tog rnams gser gyi rang bzhin la rtsa ba rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin no/ /39wa 736

dngul gyi shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab nyam dang / me tog rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams bai drur+ya'i rang bzhin no/ /be+e drur+ya'i shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang ske/ sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab nam dang / me tog rnams be+e drur+ya'i rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams shel gyi rang bzhin no/ /shel gyi shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab nim dang / me tog rnams shel gyi rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams spug gi rang bzhin no/ /spug gi shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po pyadang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab zim dang / me tog rnams spug gi rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin no/ /mu tig dmar po'i shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang ske/ lo ma dang / 'dab 6ma dang / me tog rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo'i snying po'i shing ljon pa rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang /'dab 7ma dang / me tog rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin la 'bras bu rnams gser gyi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba 8rnams gser gyi rang bzhin la sdong po rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin/ yal ga rnams be+e drur+ya'i rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams shel gyi rang bzhin/ 'dab 9ma rnams spug gi rang bzhin/ me tog 1 rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin/ 'bras bu rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni 11rtsa ba rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin la sdong po rnams bai drur+ya'i rang bzhin/ yal ga 33—737

rnams shel gyi rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams spug gi rang bzhin/ 'dab0)ma rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin / me tog rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin 'bras bu rnams gser gyi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba rnams bai drur+ya'i rang bzhin la sdong po rnams shel gyi rang bzhin/yal ga rnams spug gi rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin/'dab ma rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin/ me tog rnams gser gyi rang bzhin/'bras bu rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba rnams shel gyi rang bzhin la sdong po rnams spug gi rang bzhin/ yal ga rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin 'dab 5nom rnams gser gyi rang bzhin/ me tog rnams cadangul gyi rang bzhin/'bras bu rnams be+e drur+ya'i rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba rnams spug gi rang bzhin la sdong po rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin/yal ga rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams gser gyi rang bzhin/'dab skum rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin/ me tog rnams bai drur+ya'i rang bzhin/'bras bu rnams shel gyi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni sne/rtsa ba rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin ci/ sdong po rnamasaman/rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin/ yal ga rnams gser gyi rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin / 'dab 9ma rnams bai dūr+ya'i rang bzhin/ me tog rnams shel gyi rang bzhin / 'bras bu rnams spug gi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba rnams rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin la sdong po rnams gser gyi rang bzhin / yal ga rnams dngul gyi rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams bai drur+ya'i rang 39—738

bzhin / 'dabs1)ma rnams shel gyi rang bzhin/ me tog rnams spug gi rang bzhin 'bras bu rnams mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa kha cig ni rtsa ba rnams rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin lan/ sdong po rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin/ yal ga rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin/ lo ma rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin/ /'dabasnyem rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin/ me tog rnams kyang rin po che gesna bdun gyi rang bzhin/ 'bras bu rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo shing ljon pa de dag thams cad kyi zhirtsa ba dang ske/ sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab 'am dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams ni 'jam pa reg na bde ba/ dri zhim pa dag go / /rlung gis 57bskyod na de dag las snyan cing yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byung ste/mnyan pa dang / 'thun zhing mnyan pas nachog mi shes pa'o/ /kun dga' bo smyosangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa rnam pa de lta bu dag gis gang 1 ste/ mtha' na 11rin po che sna bdun gyi chu shing gi sdong po dang /rin po che'i shing ta la'i phreng 12gis yongs su bskor to1 / /thams cad kyang gser gyi dra bas khebs pa'o/ /kun tu rin po che sna bdun gyi pad ma rnams kyis khebs pa'o⑩/ /de na pad ma'i tshad dpag tshad phyed tsam geyang yod/ dpag tshad kyi tshad tsam 7yang yod/ dpag tshad gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum dang ske/ bzhi dang / lnga'i tshad tsam yang yod do1 / /dpag tshad bcu'i bar gyi tshad tsam dag kyang yod do/ /rin po che'i pad ma thams cad las kyang 'od zer 1 bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug 'byung ngo / /'od zer 19gyi rtse mo thams cad 39wa 739

las kyang sangs rgyas kyis1sku gser gyi kha dog can skyesar bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis mnga' ba bye ba stong phrag sum cu rtsa pedrug drug 'byung ste/ de dag shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams 5grangs med dpag tu med pa dag tu gshegs nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang /byang gi ne kyiphyogs dang / 'og dang / steng dang / phyogs mtshams rnams su 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa grangs med dpag tu med pa dag tu gshegs nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na ri nag po rnams ye med do / /ri thams cad kyang rin po che'i ri sha stag go/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab thams cad dang / khor yug na dang / ri'i rgyal po khor yug chen po thams cad dang / rgya nyamatsho chen po rnams med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni kun tu mnyam pa/ nyams dga' ba lag 1 mthil ltar mnyam pa/sa phyogs rin po che rnam pa 11sna tshogs kyis spras 12pa'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha ri rab kyi ngos la gnas pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha 1lhari rab kyi rtse mo la gnas pa de dag gang na gnas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ji snyam du sems/ 'di na 1 ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi gong ma yang 'thab bral 15gyi lha rnams dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun tson 'don dang / tshangs chen nas 'og min gyi bar gyi lha rnams gang na gnas/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / las mngon par 'du bgyid pa bsam 39—740

gyis mi khyab po/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / las mngon par 'du byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni snyed 1par rung gi/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dge ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / byin gyi rlabs 2bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni sus kyang mtha' 'am/tshad rtogs pa'am/ bsam par mi nus te/ gzhan du na sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes rab tu 'byed do/ /de ltar sems can bsod nams byas pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i 4bsod nams dang / ye shes dang /rdzu 'phrul dang / 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 5der 'byung ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni de la dogs 6pa'am/yid gnyis sam/ the tsom 7)ma mchis te/ bdag ni ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi dogs pa dang naci/ yid gnyis dang / the tsom 9bsal ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo legs so legs so/ /de lta bu ni khyod kyi bya ba yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de na chu klung rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'bab ste/ de na chu klung chen po kha tshon 1 dpag tshad tsam dag kyang yod11/dpag tshad bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu'i bar dang / kha tshon 12dpag tshad dbargya stong gi tshad tsam dag kyang yod de/zabs su ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa dag yod do / /chu klung de dag thams cad kyang spos dri rab tu zhim pa sna tshogs kyi chur 'bab cing rin po che'i me tog sil ma'i tshogs dang ska'abab pa dag go/ /sgra dbyangs snyan pa tha dad pa sna tshogs dang yang ldan pa dag go/ /kun dga' bo chu klung chen po de dag las 39—741

lha'i glu dbyangs yan lag bye ba brgya stong dang ldan pa'i sil snyan dag mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa bas lhag pa'i sgra yid du 'ong ba 'byung ste/ chu klung chen po de dag las rnam pa 'di lta bu'i sgra 'byung ba ni zab pa dang / kun 17shes par bya ba dang / rnam par shes par bya ba dang / brdzun pa sum yin pa dang / rna bar 5bde ba dang / snying du 'ong ba dang / dga' bar bya ba dang / snyan pa dang la / yid du 'ong ba dang / mnyan pas rigechog mi shes pa dang / mnyan pa dang ske/ 'thun pa dang / mi rtag pa dang / zhi ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / mnyan na bde ba ste/ de dag sems can de dag gi rna ba'i dbang po la grag phyigo/ /kun dga' bo chu klung chen po de dag gi 'gram gnyis ni rin po che'i naspos kyi shing ljon pa dag gis gang ste/ de dag la yal ga dang / lo ma dang ske/ me tog dang / dog pa sna tshogs 'phyang ngo / /de na sems can gang dag chu klung gi 'gram de dag tu zang zing med pa'i shulha'i dga' ba dang / rtse shenab myong bar 'dod pa de dag chu klung de dag tu 'jug pa'i tshe 'dod na chu long bu nub tsam du gnas so/ /'dod na 3 pus mo nub tsam dang / 'dod na rked nyunyapa nub tsam dang / 'dod na mchan khung nub tsam dang / 'dod na mid pa nub tsam du chu gnas par 'gyur 12te/ lha'i dga' ba dag kyang 'byung ngo / /der sems can gang dag chu grang bar gyur cig snyam du 'dod na yang de dag la bsil bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag dro bar gyur cig snyam du 'dod na yang de dag la dro bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag bsil ba dang dro bar gyur cig snyam du 'dod na yang de dag la chu de bsil ba dang dro bar 'gyur 1 te bde bar 'gyur ro/ /chu klung chen po de dag ni lha'i shing ta ma la'i lo ma dang / a ga 1 ru dang / dus kyi 29wa 742

rjes su 'brang ba dang / rgya spos dang / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / spos mchog gis bsgos 1pa'i chus nayongs su gang ste 'bab pa lha'i me tog ud pa la dang ske/ pad ma dang / ku mu da snadang / pad ma dkar po dang / dri rab tu zhim pa dag gi me tog gis khebs pa/ khol khol dag na 4bya ngang pa dang /bzhadamu dang / khrung khrung dang / ngur pa dang / ka ran da ba dang / ne tso dang ske/ ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / ku na la dang / ka la ming ka dang /rma bya la 47sogs pa sgra yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i bya'i tshogs kyis 77bsten pa/ ngang pa dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa ri/ 'bab stegs bde ba/ 'dam rdzab med pa gser gyi bye ma bdal ba dag go/ /de na gang gi tshe sems can de dag bdag cag gi bsam pa 'di 'dra ba yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig snyam du 'dod pa de'i tshe de dag gi bsam pa de lta bu dag chos dang ldan par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo chu de las yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byung ba gang yin pa des sangs rgyas kyi zhing der thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la go bar byed do/ /de na sems can gang dag chu ngogs na 'khod pa dag sgra 'di bdag cag gi rna ba'i dbang po la grag par ma gyur cig ces 'dod na des9)dag gi lha'i rna ba'i dbang po la grag par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang sgra rnam pa ji lta bu thos par 'dod pa de rnam pa de lta bu'i sgra yid du 'ong ba thos so/ /'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang ske/ dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgra dang / sa'i sgra dang /stobs kyi sgra dang / mi 'jigs pa'i sgra dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i sgra dang / mngon par shes pa'i sgra dang / so so yang dag par 1 rig pa'i 33—743

sgra dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang /dngos po med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa'i sgra dang / zhi ba dang / rab tu zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba'i sgra dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang ske/ dga' ba 1chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po'i sgra dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i sa rab tu thob pa'i sgra dag thos so/ /des sgra rnam pa de lta bu thos nas dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po thob po/ /dben pa dang ldan pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ldan pa dang ske/ zhi ba dang ldan pa dang / 'gog pa dang ldan pa dang / chos dang ldan pa dang / byang chub yongs su 'grub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa'i sgra 'byung ngo ske/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na mi dge ba'i ming yong 2med do/ /sgrib pa'i sgra yong med do/ /ngan song ngan 'gro rnam par ltung ba'i sgra yang yong 4med do/ /sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang yong ra med do/ /kun dga' bo de na 6sdug bsngal yang ma yin / bde ba yang na ma yin pa'i tshor ba'i sgra yang med na sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang 9lta ga la yod/ kun dga' bo mdor bsdu 1 rin rnam grangs 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams 11bde ba can zhes bya ste/rgyas par 12ni ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo rgyas par byas 12na bskal 1 pa'am bskal 15pa las lhag pa 10zad zad du 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi bde ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod kyang bde ba'i rgyu de dag gi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can der sems can gang dag 1 skyes pa dang / skye ba dang / skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang gzugs dang /39—744

kha dog dang / stobs dang / mthu dang / chu zheng dang / dbang dang /bsod nams bsags pa dang / mngon par shes pa dag dang / gos dang /rgyan dang / skyed mos tsho1)tshal dang / gzhal med khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa yongs su spyad pa rnam pa de lta bu dag dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang ske/ ro dang / reg bya yongs su spyad pa rnam pa 2de lta bu dag dang /longs spyod dang / yongs su spyad pa rnam pa 3de lta bu thams cad dang ldan te/dper na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang 'dra'o/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi sems can dag kham gyis 4za ba rags pa'i kha zas mi za'i5tsho// kha zas rnam pa ji lta bu 'dod pa 6rnam pa de lta bu 'byor pa nyid du shes te/ lus tshim par 'gyur / /gzugs tshim par 'gyur ro/ /9de dag yang lus la 'jug par mi byed do/ /de dag lus tshim nas spos kyi rnam pa ji lta bu 'dod pa de nya lta bu'i lha'i spos kyi rnam pa dag 11gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad bdugs par 'gyur ro/ /de na gang dri de la snom 12par mi 'dod pa de la spos dri'i 'du shes dang bsgos pa tsam yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur rol/ /de ltar gang dag spos dang / phreng 13ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang ske/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan 1 rnam pa ji lta bu dag 'dod pa de dag gi rnam pa de 15lta bu de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de thams cad yongs su khyab par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gos kha dog tha dad pa glukha dog brgya 1 stong du ma ci 'dra ba 'dod pa de lta bu'i gos rin po che dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de thams cad yongs su khyab par 'gyur zhing lus la bgos par bdag nyid kyis shes so/ /de dag 'di lta ste/ mgo'i 18rgyan nam/ rna 39wa 745

ba'i rgyan nam/ mgul ba dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa'i rgyan 'di lta ste/cod pan dang / rna cha0)dang / gdu ri bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / do shal dang ske/ se mo do dang / rnam nargyan dang / sor gdub 3)dang / gser gyi tsong tsong 5dang / ska56)rags dang / gser gyi dra ba dang / mu tig gi dra ba dang /rin po che thams cad kyi dril bu g.yer ku'i 7)dra ba dang / rgyan ji lta bu 'dod pa rnam pa de lta bu'i rgyan rin po che brgya stong du mas spras pa dag ⑧'di lta ste/rin po che'i shing ljon pa la 'phyang bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de gang bar mthong ste/rgyan de dag gis bdag brgyan par yang shes so/ /de dag gang kha dog dang /rtags dang / dbyibs dang / chu zheng gi bar dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi ba gam brgya stong gis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri lha'i ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba/ sngas khra bo bzhag pa dang ldan pa'i gzhal med khang ji lta bu7'dod pa de lta bu'i gzhal med khang de dag de dag gi mdun du 'byung ste/ de dag rin po che'i gzhal med khang grub pa de dag gi nang na lha'i bu mo bdunam7stong bdun stong gis yongs su bskor cing 11mdun gyis bltas nas 'khod deXrnye/ rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 1 spyod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na lha dang mi rnams tha dad pa med de/ gzhan du na kun rdzob kyi tha snyad kyis lha dang mi zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba ni ma gtogs so/ /kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na 'khor los sgyur khaba'i rgyal po'i mdun na mami ma rabs dang mi za ma ni lam 7me ma yin / lhan ne ma yin/ lhang nge ma yin zhing mi 'jigs pa ma yin la 'odamunagasal ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi 12mdun na lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang 'di lta ste/ skyed nyukhemos tshal dang / gzhal 39—746

med khang dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / dbang71 /dang / rdzu 'phrul dang /cho 'phrul dang / dbang phyug gis lamatsha me ma yin/ lhan ne ma yin/ lhang nge ma yin te/ chos mngon par rtogs pa dang / chos la yongs su spyod pa ni ma gtogs so/ /kun ngaga' bo de la gzhan 'phrulamari nodabang byed kyi lha rnams54)ci 'dra ba 45)de 'dra bar bde ba can gyi kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi rnams blta bar bya'o / /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de na snga dro'i dus nye bar gnas pa'i tshe phyogs bzhi kun nas 'khrugs pya shing kun tu zheda'akhrugs pa'i rlung ldang59)ste/ de dag gis rin po che'i shing ljon pa bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog tha dad pa/ kha dog du ma yod pa/ lha'i spos dri rab tu zhim pa sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa de dag bskyod/ kun tu bskyod/ bsgul kun tu bsgul nas de dag las me tog rnam pa mang po'i dri 7yid du 'ong ba'i bsung can blta na sdug pa dag rin po che'i sa chen po de la 'brul te/ me tog de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de kun tu mi 'greng nyu1bdun srid tsam 32du bkram par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ dper na rje)sa bu sa la me tog 'grems mkhas pa zhig gis lag pa gnyis kus 1lhabakram ste/ mnyam par bkod na shin tu bkra zhing blta na sdug go/ /de bzhin du me tog bsung /mudang / kha dog tha dad pa dang ldan pamotshede dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de kun tu mi 'greng bdun tsam 8khyab par 'gyur ro/ /me tog gi 1 mornam pa de dag ni 'jam pa ste/ dpe tsam du na gos ka tsa lin di nyusheltar reg na bde ba'o/ /de dag ni 37rkang pa 'jog pa 2 na sor bzhi tsam gyis dma' bar 'gyur zhing rkang pa 'deg 21pa na sor bzhi tsam gyis mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /snga dro'i dus 'das nas ni 22me tog de dag kyang ma lus pa 22med par 'gyur te/39wa 747

de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dben pa 1dang / nyams dga' ba dang /dag par 'gyur zhing me tog snga ma rnams kyis rnyogasam pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang phyogs bzhi kun nas rlung langs te/ gang sngon ma byung ba'i me tog sar ripa dag mngon par 'thor 4ro/ /snga dro 5ji lta bar nyi ma'i gung dang /phyi dro'i dus kyi tshe dang / mtshan mo dang kyi/ srod dang / nam gyi gung dang /tho rangs 7kyang de bzhin no/ /spos /dri sna tshogs kyis bsgos pa'i rlung de dag langs nas sems can de dag la reg na 'di lta ste/ dper na dge slong 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs pa ‘ lta bu'i bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na de bzhin gshegs pas bsnyad pa ma gtogs par me dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang /skar ma'i gzugs dang / mun pa mun gnag 1 gi ming du gdags pa yong med do / /nyin mo dang / mtshan mor 11gdags pa yang yong med do/ /khyims32yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyang yong med 12do/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de na dus dus su lha'i spos chu'i sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab po/ /lha'i me tog kha dog thams cad dang ldan pa dag dang / lha'i rin po che sna bdun dang / lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i gdugs dang /rgyal 15mtshan dang / ba dan gyi char mngon par 'bab po/ /lha'i bla re dag kyang 'dzin to/ /lha'i rin po che'i gdugs rnga ma'i bsil yab dang bcas pa dag kyang nam mkha' la 'dzin to/ /lha'i rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dag kyang sgrogs shing lha'i bu mo dag kyang gar byed do/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems can gang dag skyes pa dang skye ba dang 7/ skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams 39—748

cad mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du yang dag pa nyid du nges par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 1'di lta ste/ ma nges pa dang / log pa nyid du nges pa'i na phung po gnyis rnam par gzhag pa'am gdags pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo mdor bsdu na rnam grangs 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams de cing)bde ba can zhes bya ste rgyas par ni ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo rgyas par bstan na ni bskal 5pa zad zad du 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi bde ba'i rgyu rnams yongs su brjod kyang bde ba'i rgyu de dag gi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag 6)bka' stsal to / /sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs gyur la/ /dam pa'i don mkhas ye shes rnam dag ste/ /de dag bskal 7pa'am 'on te lhag par ni/ /bde ba can gyi bsngags pa rab brjod kyang / /bsngags pa'i phreng 8)ba rab tu brjod pa na / /bskal ḍapa bye ba de dag zad 'gyur gyi/ /bde ba can gyi bsngags pa mthar mi phyin/ /de dag spobs 1 pa'ang zad par 'gyur ma yin/ /gang gis phra rab rdul snyed 'jig rten khams/ /bshig cing btags te rdul 11du byas gyur pa / /de bas mang ba'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnams/ /rin chen bkang ste sbyin pa byin pas 12ni/ /gang gis dpag tu med pa'i 'od mtshan dang / /bde ba can gyi yon tan khyad 1 'phags rnams/ /thos nas dga' ste thal mo sbyor byed pa / /bsod nams 'di yi char yang 'gyur ma yin/ /de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa 'de'i/ /yon tan thos nas mgu dadang dad skyed sal/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams mchog tu/ /'gro bar bya phyir mos pa drag po bskyed17/ /gang gis bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi/ /ming thos pa yi bsod nams de la ni/ /39—749

zhing mchog tha grupha3)chen po de dag kun/ /cha dang dperadzan/yang 'gyur ba ma yin no / /gang dag rgyal ba'i bka' dang shes rab can/ /de dag de bas bsod nams mang du 'gyur/ /don dam thob phyir dad pa rtsa ba5kyeste/ /de lta bas na thos nas yid gnyis solage/ /kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi yon tan dang / bsngags pa de ltarapo dpag tu med do/ /kun dga' bo phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang gosangs rgyas kyi77)zhing gang gā'i〈klung gi bye ma snyed dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i ga'o)klung gi 7bye ma snyed dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i mtshan yongs su rjodatshwa tshedo / /bsngags pa gsung ngo / / grags pa lha rab tu sgrogs so/ /yon tan rjodacado / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can gang dag kha cig7gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de'i mtshan thos la thos nas kyang tha na sems bskyed pa gcig tsam zhig bsam pa thag pa nas dad pa dang dga' ba bskyed7pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo sems can gang dag kha cig ni 8de bzhin gshegs pa de rnam pas 1 tshoyang dang yang du 12yid la byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa bskyed 9pa dang / byang chub tu sems 3 )yongs su bsngos te/'jig rten gyi khams der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na 2lhade bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de dge slong gi tshogs du mas yongs su bskor cing༄rtemadun gyis bltas nas bzhugs par 'gyur te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de mthong nas rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis shi 'phos te/ 'jig 39—750

rten gyi khams bde ba can de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la dag stigis tshe 'di nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med mthong yang ci ma rung snyam /du sems patre ༄des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i rgyud kyis byasangs rgyas kyi ⑤zhing der skye bar bya ba'i phyir sems yang dag par btang ste / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed paralo bya zhing yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gang dag yang de bzhin gshegs pa de yang yid la byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa rgyun tu bskyed gal/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der sems yang dag par gtod pa shesade dag 'chi ba'i dus nye bar gnas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu7med patshwa )de'i kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / chu zheng dang / zhabs 'bring (teb dge slong gi dge 'dun ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dag mdun du gnas par 'gyur te/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas rab tu dang ba la/ dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de 3rnyedang / rjed 1 pa med pa'i dran pas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 6sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa de tha na sems bskyed pa gcig tsam rjes su dran par byed cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar yang 1ge'adod la/ chos zab mo dag 'chad pa na dka' rkeb 'thob 1 cing skyid lug pa med la mi 'gong mi zhum zhing tha na sems bskyed pa gcig tsam de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de yid la byed de/ 'dod pa yang skyed 18na de dag rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de mthong zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba 39—751

can der skyephubar 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par yang 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa de dag don gyi dbang de gzigs nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag tu med pa dag na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i mtshan yangasnyeyongs su rjodag/ bsngags pa yang gsung bstod pa yang sgrogs so/ /kun dga' bo phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i duklung gi bye ma snyed dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de mel blta ba dang /phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su dri bar bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dngasnyi/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par de dag blta ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing der 'dong ngo / /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid rgyas par gsung zhing tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal payi/ 'dren pa 'od dpag med kyi huXsangs rgyas la/ /phyag bya'i phyir ni shar gyi sangs rgyas zhing //mtha' yas gang gā'i hu klung gi bye snyed nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag lhagasahurte/ /de dag me tog kha dog tha dad pa/ /dri zhim yid 'ong mang po snyim thogs te/ /tshe dpag med pa lha dang mis mchod pa/ /mi yi 'dren pa mchog la rab tu 'thor/ /'dren pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas la/ /phyag bya'i phyir ni de bzhin lho nub dang / /byang phyogs sangs rgyas zhing rnams ji snyed nas / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag lhags/ /de dag spos kyi kha dog tha dad pa/ /dri zhim tsoyid 'ong mang po snyim thogs te/ /tshe dpag med pa lha dang mis mchod pa/ /mi yi 'dren pa mchog la rab tu 'thor/ /byang chub 33—752

sems dpa' mang po de dag gis/ /mchod pa byas te0byedapag med 'od zhabs la / /phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas 'di skad du/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ngo mtshar mdzes shes 'dzer/ /dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems ni gzhal yas kyis/ /de dag gis ni me tog snyimashegator nas/ /'dren pa de yi spyan sngar 'di skad du / /bdag cag zhing yang 'di 'drar gyur ces7smras/ /de dag me tog snyim pa gtor ma thag /de tshe dpag tshad brgyasnyipa'i gdugs gyur te/ /legs par brgyan cingasayu ba bkra bas mdzes/ /sangs rgyas sku la kun tu khebs parasreganas / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag de bzhin du/ /bsnyen bkur byas nas dga' ste 'di skad du/ /gang dag gis ni mi mchog mtshan thos pa/ /sems can de dag rnyed pa legs rnyed 'dzer/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'diphubadag cag lhags7pas na/ /bdag cag gis ni sngon rnyed legs pararwaste rnyed/ /bskalarwatepa stong du ston pas gang bsgrubs pa/ /rmi lam lta bu'i zhing ni ci 'dra ltos/ /'od ni dpag med gzirwanyebarjid dpag med pa/ /sku tshe dpag med dge 'dun dpag med pa/ /byang chub sems dpas bskor cing tu mdzes gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams phung po mchog la ltos/ /de nas tshe dpag med kyis 'dzumachamadzad nas/ /'od 'phro bye bshekhrag khrig sum cu drug /de dag zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas phyung ste/ /zhing stong bye ba dag ni khyab par mdzad/ /'od 'phro de dag thams cad slar logarwa phoste/ /'dren pa'i spyi gtsug der ni nub par gyur/ /de tshe 'od 'phro nub par gyur nas ni/ /lha dang mi rnams dga' ba rab tu skyed/ /de nas sangs rgyas sras po grags chen po/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug de langs te/ /gang slad 'jig rten mgon po 'dzum mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan de 39—753

yi rgyu dang rkyen gang lags/ /sems can mang 'grol phan pa thugs brtse can/ /don dam mkhas pa de ni lung bstan gsol/ /gsung mchog yid du mchi btude thos nasangs/ /sems can dag ni dga' ba'i sems su 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams mang byang chub sems dpa' dag /sangs rgyas blta slad bdesacan 'dir mchi babya/ /de dag thos nas dga' ba cher skyedakyide/ /myur du zhing 'di rnam par lta7bar 'gyurag/ /rgya chen zhing 'disalhags par gyur nas kyang / /lha yi mig dang lha yi rna ba dang / /tshe rabs dran dang blo gros mkhas mchog dang / /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyang myur du thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyis lung bstan pa/ /ngas ni sngon tshe smon lam 'di skad btab/ /sems can dgashegis nga yi ming thos na/ /nga yi zhing du rtag tu 'ong bar shog /nga yi smon lam bzang po de rdzogs pas/ /'jig rten khams mang dag nas sems can 'ong / /de dag nga yi zhing du lhags bonas ni/ /de dag skye ba gcig las phyir mi ldog /de (1phyir byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig 'dir/ /bdag gi zhing yang 'di 'drar 'gyur brwanyedang / /bdag gi7ming dang sgra dang lta bas kyang / /sems can mang po dgrolachabar bya 'dod pa/ /de ni myur du rings par la gor du/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams song la/ /'od dpag med kyi gan du song nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong la mchod pa gyis/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis zhing mang song nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la mchod byas te⑩/ /bde bar gshegs la mchod pa byas nas kyang / /dro khar bde ba can du slar yang 'ong ske// //bam po gsum pa(sri/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 33—754

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de'i byang chub kyi shing ni 'phang du dpag tshad stong drug brgyam༅yod pa/ yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'daba'arim dpag tshad brgyad brgya ri /tshun chad du 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba'i sboms 4)dang /khrun dpag tshad lnga brgya55tsho/yod pa6/ rtag tu lo ma chags pa/ rtag tu me tog chags pa/ rtag tu 'bras bu chags pa/ kha dog tha dad pa/ kha dog brgya9nastong du ma yod pa/ lo ma tha dad pa/ me tog tha dad pa/ 'bras bu tha dad pal / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba lta bur snang ba'i nor bu rin po ches yongs su gsal ba/ brgyas1)byin thogs pa'i nor bu rin po ches rnam par spras pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches gang ba/ rgya mtsho'i nor bu rin po che mchog gis shin tu rnam par spras pa/ kha dog lha'i las 'das pa/ gser gyi skud pa 'phyang /nyab/ se mo do mdzes pa dang / rin po che'i chun po dang /rgyan phreng 3)dang / do shal tshig rkyang kyi dang / mu tig dmar po'i rgyan phreng0rtedang ske/ mu tig sngon po'i rgyan phreng 7dang / seng ge'i kha nas ga'aphyang ba'i skamatsharags kyi tshogs yod pa / nyi rin po che'i skud pa dang 3she/ rin po che thams cad dang / dung gis7)mngon par spras pa/ gser gyi dra ba dang / mu tig gi dra ba dang / rin po che thams cad kyi dra ba dang / dril bu ni snagayer ma'i ri 1dra bas bla remanyebres pa/ chu srin dang / bkra shisadza snyedang / g.yung drung 'khyil pa dang /zla gam lta bus 2helegs par brgyan pa/ nor bu 'khrol ba dang / gser dang /rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can gyi bsam pa'i rnam par rig pa ji lta ba bzhin du legs par brgyan pa'o/ /kun dga' bo byang chub kyi shing de ni zhu2rlung gis bskyod pa 2dzin sgra dbyangs 'byung ba gang yin pa des 'jig 39wa 755

rten gyi khams tshad med pa go bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo de la byang chub kyi shing gi sgra de sems can gang dag gi rna lam du grag pa de dag byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du rna nad kyis mi btab par shes par bya'o/ /sems can dpag tu med/grangs med/ bsam gyis 1mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med/ tshad med / brjod du med pa gang dag gi mig lam du byang chub kyi shing de snang ba de dag 5byang chub kyi mtha'i bar dus mig nad kyis mi btab par shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo sems can gang dag byang chub kyi shing de'i dri tshor ba de dag kyang byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du nam yang sna nad kyis mi btab par shes par bya'o/ /sems can gang dag 4)byang chub kyi 5shing de'i 'bras bu'i ro myong ba de dgang kyang byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du nam yang lce nad kyis mi btab par shes par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi shing de'i 'od kyis sems can gang dag lamartso)khyab par gyur pa de dag kyang byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du nam yang lus la nad kyis mi btab par shes par bya'ol/ /kun dga' bo sems can gang dag byang chub kyi shing de chos nyid du nges par sems pa de dag kyang deng nas 8bzung ste/ byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du nam yang sems mi g.yeng bar shes par bya'o/ /sems can de dag thams cad ni byang chub kyi 9)shing de mthong ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med de nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs 1 dang / sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba 31byas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam dang / spyod pa shin tu rdzogs pa dang ske/ shin tu bsgoms pa dang / mi nyung ba dang / ma tshang ba med pas 'di lta ste/ sgra'i rjes su 'gro ba dang / rjes su 'thun pa dang / mi skye ba'i chos la 39—756

bzod pa dang / bzod pa rnam pa 1tshogasum 'thob bo/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa dang / skye ba dang /skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad skye ba gcig gis thogs par gyur nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ smon lam gyi dbang ni ma gtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ go cha rgya 2chen po bgos pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba la brtson pa sha stag go/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 4nyan thos gang dag 'khod pa de dag ni 'od 'dom gang ba sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 'khod pa de dag ni 'od dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong pa sha stag ster/ byang chub sems dpa' gang 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams de rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par khor zug 6tu snang bas khyab par byed pa des47riganyis ni ma gtogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de gnyis kyi na ming ci zhes bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de gnyis la gcig gi ming ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bya'ol/ /gcig gi ming ni mthu 9 chen thob ces bya ste/ kun dga' bo de gnyis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes so/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa de dag thams cad ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ lus yongs su rdzogs pa/ bsam gtan dang mngon par shes pa la mkhas pa/ shes 39—757

rab kyis rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pa/ dbang po rno ba/ dbang po bsdams pa kun shes pa'i dbang po dang ldan pa/ ma zhum pa / dbang po mi g.yo ba/bzod pa thob pa/ yon tan mtha' yas pa mu0)med pa sha stag go/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa de dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi bralakeb/ byang chub kyi mtha'i bar du log par mi ltung ba'i chos can sha stag ste/ de dag thams cad 'di nas nye bar bzung nasar nam yang tshe rabs mi dran par mi 'gyur gyis mtshe rabs dran par 'gyur te/ gang dag dper na da ltar gyi ngane'ubazhin du snyigs ma lnga'i dus na gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i bskal pas dkrugs mapa dag tu gnas par sngon smon lam btab pa rnams ni ma gtogs so/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa de dag thams cad snga dro gcig bzhin 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag du dong nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ④byi ba khrag khrig phrag du ma la bsnyen bkur byed de/ de dag rnam pa 'di lta bu'i me tog dang /bdug pa dang / mar me dang / spos dang / phreng byu1)ba dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyalam mtshan dang / ba dan dang /sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs dang / rol mo'i dbyangs sgra dag gis mchod parwasnrobya'ol/ /snyam du ji lta ji ltar 12sems bskyed cing ji ltararwanya'adod pa rnams de dag gis sems bskyed ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus rnam pa de lta bu'i mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad lag pa nas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis me tog nas rol mo'i dbyangs sgra'i bar de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de 33—758

dag la mchod pa byed la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po tshad med grangs med pa dag kyang skyed7cing stsogs sogaci/ /gal te me tog gi skon bu rnam pa55)'di lta bu lalag pa55)nas 'byung 6)bar gyur cig ces 'dod na yang de dag gis sems bskyed ma thag tu lha'i〈me tog kha dog natha dad pa/ dri tha dad pa dri du ma yod 1pa'i skon bu dag lag pa nas 'byung ste1 / de dag gis skon bu'i 11me tog rnam pa de lta bu de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la 'thor mngon par 'thoranyu2/mngon par rab tu 'thor12/ skon bu'i me tog gtor ba de dag thams cad las nang gi chung ngu gang yin pa de yang steng 3 gi bar snang la dpag tshad bcu'i tshad tsam gyi me tog gi gdugs su 'gyur te/ phyi ma shos ma gtor gyi bar du 8snga ma sa la mi ltung ngo / /de na skon bu'i me tog gtor ba gang steng gi bar snang la dpag tshad nyi shu'i tshad tsam gyi gdugs su 'gyur ba yang yod/ dpag tshad sum cu dang bzhi bcu'i tshad tsam yang yod/ steng gi bar snang la me tog gi gdugs dpag tshad brgyas stong gi tshad kyi bar tsam du 'gyur ba dag nyanyekyang yod do/ /de na gang dag dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po skyed0(cing sems dga' ba rgya (3 chen po thob nas 21dge ba'i rtsa ba grangs med dpag tu med pa bskyed nas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya na stong phrag mang po la bsnyen bkur byas te snga dro gcig la slar log nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du gnas so / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs shu kyis yongs su zin pa dang sngon chos mnyan pa byin pa dang ske/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam 'byor cing thuyongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi nyung ba dang / shin tu rnam par phye 39—759

ba dang / shin tu bsgoms pas smon lam btab pa 'grub po1kyi/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i chos kyi gtam smra ba dag gol/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na sems can gang nadag yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'du shes 'ga' yang mi skyed de ri/ de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing deras kun tu 5'chag cing rnam par rgyu ba na dga' ba dang / mi dga' ba mi skyed 6do/ /'gro ba na yang ltos pa med pa nyid du 7'gro'i ltos pa dang bcas par da ma yin rnal/ /'di lta ste/ dngos po yongs su 'dzin pa dang / gnas kyi sems dang /sems de lta bu dag de dag 9la tshayong med do/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can der skyes pa de dag la gzhan gyi 'du shes med/ rang gi 'du shes med/ bdag gi 'du shes med/ 'thab pa med ske/ rtsod pa med/ mi 'thun pa med/ mi mnyam pa'i sems med de/ de dag ni sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa dang / phan pa'i sems dang /byams pa'i sems dang / mnyen pa'i sems dang / 'jam pa'i sems dang /dge ba'i sems dang / rab tu dang ba'i sems dang / brtan pa'i sems dang ske/ sgrib pa med pa'i sems dang / 'khrugs 12pa med pa'i sems dang /rtog 1 pa med pa'i sems dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa spyod pa'i sems dang / sems kyi rgyud lha sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la blo rab tu zhugs pa/shes rab rgya mtsho 15chen po dang mnyam pa/ blo ri rab dang mtshungs pa/ yon tan du ma bsags 17pa byang chub 1 kyi yan lag yang dag par 'gro 18bas rnam par rtsen 19pa/ sangs rgyas yang dag par 'gro ba la mngon par brtson pa/ sha'i 21wa 760

mig rab tu rnam par 'byed pa/ lha'i mig mngon par sgrub0)pa/ shes rab kyi mig rtogs par7khong du chud pa/ chos kyi mig gi pha rol tu son pa/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrubashecing 'chad de ston pa④rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cing chags pa med pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub pa/ khams gsumasnyimanyam pa nyid du mngon par brtson pa/ sems dul ba/ sems zhi ba/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa/ kun 'byung ba'i nges pa'i tshig la mkhas pa/ chos kyi nges pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ gsal ba dang mi gsal7ba la mkhas pa/ tshul dang tshul ma yin pa'i gnas la mkhas pa/ 'jig rten pa'i gtam la mi lta bar gnas pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtam rnams kyis57snying po rtogs pa chos thams cad yongs su tshol ba la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ⑧nye bar zhi bar shes pas gnas pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i spyod yul ba/ ci yang med pa/ len pa med pa/ sems pa med pa/ phung po med pa/ len pa med pas shin tu rnam par grol7ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ mngon par shes pa rnams la thug pa med par gnas pa/ rtsa ba med pa la gnas pa/ sems chags pa med pa zhum pa med pa/ chos zab pas/lharnams la mngon par brtson pa/sgyid lug pa med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rtogs par dka' ba la 'jug pas 'phags pa/ bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam rjes su thob pa the tsomatshwa med pa/dogs pa las rgal〈nyeb/ shes pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa8/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal med pa/ ye shes kyis mngon par 'phags te ri rab dang mtshungs pa/'khrugs pa med pa'i7blos rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba/ shes rab kyi 'od dang / dkar zhing yishin tu dkar la dag cing dge ba'i sems dang / gser btso ma'i 39—761

kha dog 'dra bar snang zhing 'od 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi mchog gis nyi zla'i 'od las shin tu 'das pa/ sems can thams cad kyishedage ba dngas mi dge ba5kyibazod pas sa dang mtshungs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khru bar 'bab pas chu dang 'dra ba/ chos thams cad la rlom sems su byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa sregs pa'i phyir me'i rgyal 5)po dang mtshungs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad la mi chags pa'i phyir rlung dang 'dra ba/ chos thams cad nges par phigs 6)pa dang /thams cad du ci yang med pa'i phyir nam mkha' dang mtshungs pame/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis ⑧mi gos pa'i phyir pad ma dang 'dra ba/ chos dang chos ma yin pa 7)mngon par sgrogs pas dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'brug chen po dang mtshungs pa / chos kyi chu'i char mngon par 'bebs7pas char pa chen po dang 'dra ba tshogs chen po zil gyis gnon pas khyu mchog dang mtshungs pa/ sems shin tu mchog tu dul bas glang po che 11chen po dang 'dra ba shin tu dul bas rta cang shes bzang po dang mtshungs pa/ rtsal dang mi 'jigs pas skrag pa med pa'i phyir ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge dang 'dra ba/ sems can thams cad 12yongs su skyob nyartepas shing gi rgyal po n+ya 1 gro dha 15dang mtshungs pa/ pas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi g.yos pas ri'i rgyal por ri rab dang 'dra ba/ byams pa tshad med pa bsgoms pas nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi dbang du sabya ba'i sngon du 'gro bas tshangs pa chen po dang 'dra ba/ gnas su stsogs nya pa med pas bya dang mtshungs pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pas bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba13/ 'byung bar 19dka' ba'i phyir u dum ba na ra'i me tog dang mtshungs pa/ glang po che 1ltar shin tu mnyam par 39wa 762

gzhag pas0)rnam par g.yeng ba med pa/ dbang po rmugs pa med pa/ rnam par gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa/ bzod pa dang nges pa mang ba pha rol phun sum tshogs par smon pas phrag dog med pa/ chos kyi gtam rnams la 'jigs pa med pa chos yongs su tshol bas ngoms mi myong ba/ tshul khrims kyisam ge)bai drur+ya dang 'dra ba/ thos pas tshirin po che'i 'byung gnas dang mtshungs pa chos kyi rnga sgra chen pos sgra snyan pa/ chos kyi rnga chen po rdung54)ba/ chos kyi dung chen po 'bud pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po sgreng bsti/ chos kyi ba dan chen po 'dzin pa/ chos kyi sgron ma chen po rab tu 'bar bar byed pa/ shes rab kyis rnam par lta ba rmongs pa med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ tha ba btulashone/ba/dag pa/ dri nga ba med pa/ brkam pa med pa/ yang dag par 'ged pa 3)la dga' ba/ gtong ba btang ba/ sbyin pa la melag brkyang ba/ chos dang zang zing yang dag par 'gyed ⑨pa la dga' ba/ sbyin pa la ser sna med pa/ 'dres pa med pa/ yid 'jigs pa med pa/ chags pa med pa/ brtan pa/ dpa' brka/ gces patshatshe'adzin pa/ mos pa dang ldan pa/ ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pa/zug rngu phyung51ba/ gtan pa med pa/ mngon par shes pa thob pa/ des pa/ 'grogs na tsho/sebade ba/ don byed pa/ 'jig rten gsal bar byed 9/gepa/'dren pa/ dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang / rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba spangs pasnyi/ dag pa/ mya ngan dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma gsum spangs pa/ mngon par shes pas rnam par rtsen mapa/ rgyu'i stobs can/ smon lam gyi stobs can/ mi dman pa/ gya gyu med pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ nga rgyal gyi zug rngu bton pa/39—763

'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang bral ba/ dag pa/ dge ba la mos pa/ rgyal ba dam pas bsngags pa91/ 'jig rten la 0mkhas pa/sbyangs pa'i ye shes yang dag par bsgrubs pa/ rgyal bas bstod pa/ sems dga' ba dang ldan pa/ rtul phod 3pa/ sran thub pa/ mnyam pa med pa/ tha ba med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ rdul med pa/ 'dus pa rgya che ba/ khyu mchog tu gyur pa/ bden pa smra ba/ blo dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pa/ blo gros dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ shes rab kyi mtshon cha'i lag cha 4)can/bsod nams dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ tha ba dang / dri ma dang /khong khro ba dang bral ba/ chos la rtag tu brtson pa/ chos thams cad la thos pa rgya mtsho lta bur gyur pa sha stag go/ /kun dga' bo mdor bsdu ra na sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i 6byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'di lta bu sha stag ste/ rgyas par bya77)na gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i 8che'i tshad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya 'ostong du gnas pas bstan kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi yon tan gyi mtha' bstan par mi nus la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i 1 ciyang rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi yon tan rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi spobs pa bla na med pa de gnyis ka yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo longs la nub phyogs su phyogs te me tog gtor la thal mo sbyor 11te/ gang na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med rdul med cing rnam par dag pa bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes 2shing chos kyang 1 ston pa'i phyogs der phyag 39wa 764

'tshol cig /de'i mtshan de yang sgrib pa med par phyogs bcur grags gi1te/phyogs re re na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gsung nachags pa mi mnga' zhing gsung thogs pa mi mnga' ba gang gā'i /klung gi bye ma snyed dag lan 'ga' ri sgom yin par bsngags pa brjod cing bstod 5de/ snyan par 6gsung ngo / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu 7med pa de dang na /tshe dpag tu 9med pa de 1 dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya 11stong mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa de dag la lta 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshig 'di smras ma thag tu de nas de'i mod la 32de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i phyag gi mthil nas 'od gang gis nasangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya 1 stong snang bas khyab par 'gyur ba sade lta bu'i po'od phyung 1 ngo / /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya 18stong thams cad na 19ri nag po'am/ rin po che'i ri'am/lhun po'am/ lhun po chen po'am/ btang bzung ngams / btang bzung 21chen po'am / khor yug gam/ khor yug chen po'am/ brtsigs 22pa'am ka ba'am / shing ljon pa stug po'am/ skyed dmos tshal 2 lam/ gzhal med khang ngam pa / lha dang mi gang su dag yod pa de dag thams cad las de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i 'od kyis thal bar gyur cing 20zil gyis non par gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar nas mi zhig 'dom 2 gang tsam na 'dug pa la mi zhig lta 28ba de bzhin du de'i tshe 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi 39—765

mthu dang / 'od 1de yongs su dag pa'i phyir dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang —/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yinas yidang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye /chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas mngon par 'phags te/ phyogs thams cad zil gyis mnan nas/lham 4me/ lhan ne lhang nge 5mdzes pa de dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de 6dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun de la lta'o / /'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po 'di chu gcig tu gyur na de la shing ljon pa rnams med/ ri rnams med / gling rnams med/ rtswa rin)dang / shing gel pa dang / sman dang /nags tshal rnams med/ chu klung79)rnams med cing ngam grog dang / g.yang sa rnams mi snang ste/ gzhan du na sa chen po rgya mtsho gcig tu gyur pa ni ma gtogs sol/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na nyan thos rnams kyi lus las mngon par grub pa'i 'od 'dom gang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'od dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong yod pa ma gtogarme par gzhan rtags sam/ mtshan ma cung 1 zad kyang 12med do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med des nyan thos kyi tshogs de dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de zil gyis mnan nas phyogs thams cad du gsal bar kun tu snang ngo / /de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can der byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams 39—766

cad dang0)/ lha dang mi de dag thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjedarka'adi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya ri)thub pa dge slong gi dge 'dun chen pos bskor cing 4)chos ston pa yang snang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi pham 5pa la bka' stsal pa/mi pham57pa khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa 'di dang / steng gi bar snang la kun dga'i ra ba nyams 7dga' ba dag dang / nags tshal nyams dga' ba dgaston/dang / skyed phyo)mos tshal nyams dga' ba dag dang / chu klung dang / rdzing bu nyams dga' ba dag dang /rin po che'i me tog pad ma dang / ku mu da bodang / pad ma dkar pos gang ba 11dang ske/ 'og tu sa'i steng nas bzung ste/ 'og min gyi gnas kyi bar gyi nam mkha'i ngos la me tog bkram pa dang / me tog gi phreng nyi bas kun tu mdzes 12par byas pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs bkra skoba'i phreng gis gang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pas 1gisprul pa'i bya sna 17tshogs kyis bsten 1 pa mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi pham 18pa khyod kyis 'di las gzhan pa'i bya'i tshogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sgras go bar byed cing des byang chub sems dpa' de dag 19rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba 2 dag mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis 21 bka' stsal pa/ mi pham 22pa khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na sems can 'di dag gzhal med khang dpag tshad brgya sa stong yod pa dag tu zhugs 2 te/bar snang la chags pa med par 'gro ba de 25dag mthong ngam/ gsol pa/39wa 767

bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mi pham 1/pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ gzhan 'phrulastobadabang byed kyi lha rnams dang /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skyes pa'i mi rnams tha dad du bya ba yod dam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni tha dad du bgyi ba gcig kyang yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de'i mi rnams ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'i bar du lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mi pham 5pa khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de na mi kha cig pad ma chen po dag gi mngal can gnas pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral gyi lha rnams gzhal med khang 5dpag tshad lnga bcu pa'am/ dpag tshad brgya 6)pa'am/ dpag tshad lnga brgya 7pa rnams su zhugs te/ rtse dga' zhing dga' mgur 8/spyod pa de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 9'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de'i mi kha cig pad ma chen po dag gi mngal na gnas par mthong lags so / /bcom ldan 'das de na sems can brdzus te 'byung 37ba gang dag pad ma rnams la skyil mo krung 12bcas te 'byung ba dag kyang mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kha cig pad ma'i mngal na gnas pa dang / kha cig pad ma la skyil mo krung 1 bcas nas brdzus 1 te 'byung ba de'i rgyu ni gang lags/ rkyen ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi pham 15pa byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag na gnas te/ the tshom 7du ltung 1 ba'i sems kyis 'jig rten gyi 18khams bde ba can du skye bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed 19pa de dag ni de na mngal na gnas so / /gang dag the tsom 2 med cing 39wa 768

som nyi med de/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed 1la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes chags pa med pa la yid ches shing dad la mos pa de dag ni pad ma rnams la skyil mo krungs bcas nas brdzus sate byung 4ngo / /mi pham 5pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan na gnas pa gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar sems bskyed 6cing the tsom 7mi skyed 8la/ sangs rgyas 9kyi ye shes chags pa med pa la som nyi med cing rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang sogs 1 pa de dag ni skyil mo krung 11bcas nas brdzus 12te 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ dper na byang chub sems dpa' skyes nas ring po ma lon pa gzhan 1 dag dang 'dra bar yud tsam gyis lus 1 rnam pa de lta bur 'gyur ro/ /mi pham 5pa shes rab kyi khyad par dang / shes rab kyi rim pa dang / 'di lta ste/ the tsom 7du ltung 1 ba'i 'du shes yid la byed pas 'di ltar lo lnga brgyar 18sangs rgyas mthong ba las yongs su nyams shing byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / chos mnyan 19pa dang chos kyi gtam dang ske/ dge ba'i spyod pa dang / dge ba 2 phun sum tshogs pa thams cad las yongs su nyams pa'i shes rab yongs su nyams pa dang / shes rab chung ba la ltos / mi phams 1pa 'di lta ste/ dper na rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo 2nas dbang bskur ba la khri mon gser dang / bai drur+ya thams cad kyis spras di pa/ dar dang ske/ phreng 2 rib dang / lda ldi'i tshogs spyangs 25pa/ tshon sna tshogs kyi 27bla re bres pa/ ras bcos bu bting 2 ba/ me tog na sil ma sna tshogs bkram pa/39wa 769

bdug pa rgya chen pos bdugs ༅7pa/ khang bzangasadza2)dang / bsil khang dang /skar khung dang / kha khyer dang / rta babs dang / ba gam rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gser dang / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer kha'i shedra bas bres pa/ gru bzhi lham pa pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ sgo bzhi btod pa/them skas bzhi 6bcas pa zhig yod pa57 / rgyal po de'i bu nyes pa zhig gisam58)phyir khri mon der bcug ste/ 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i 9)gser gyi khong sgril du bcug la/der de'i khri bshams te/ stan ko mini ka bting ba 11la/ bar tshangs 3nyecan dang ske/ pal li ka 32bting ste/ yul ka ling ku'i ras kyis gdingakheb bting la / de'i steng du dar bting ste/ g.yas g.yon 15gnyis su rten ma dmar po gzhag la dzibakra ba blta na sdug pa de la de 'dug kyang rung nyal yang rung / de'i zas skom 1 gtsang ma bsod 38pa rnam pa mang po du ma bshams na mi phamatshwa)pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ rgyal po'i bu de'i 2 yongs su spyod 921pa rgya che ba yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rgya che ba 22lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi pham ni pa 'di ji snyam du sems des de'i ro myong rdustebar byed dam / mid par byed dam/ des de nisnyedaga' ba 'thob sgo bam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags tezhu tsho/ nongs pa gang gis nyeslad du rgyal pos khri mon der stsal pa de las thar bar 'tshal zhing rigs bzang po rigs bzang po'i gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang / tshong dpon dang /khyim bdag dang / khams kyi rgyal po'am/ gang gis khri mon de las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba yongs su tshol te/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i bu de btson ra de na dga' ba mtshan mchis shing rgyal pos ma gnang gi bar du mi tharas ro/ /33wa 770

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi pham ti pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gang dag the tsom 2du ltung ri bas dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyedamachi cing sangs rgyas kyi 5ye shes mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ye shes la som nyi za ba de dag sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos pa de dang / sems dang ba tsam des 'jig rten gyi 6khams bde ba can der skye rige)yang pad ma rnams la skyil mo krung 8)bcas shing brdzusam9)te 'byung ba ma yin gyi pad ma rnams kyi nya snamangal na gnas pa myong ste/ de dag de las skyed mos 31tshal dang / gzhal med khang du 'du shes shing gnas te/ bshang gci nyi medam/ mchil ma med1lha/ snabs med/ yid dang mi 'thun pa mi 'byung mod kyil/ lo lnga brgyar 14sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / chos nyanamatshapa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / 'bel tshaba'i chos kyi gtam rnam par nges pa dang ske/ dge ba'i chos spyod pa thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ de dag de na mngon par mi the tshodaga' zhing mgu ba mi 'thob kyi sngon gyi712nyes pa zad nas de dag pad ma'i mngal rnams /rtenas 'byung ste/ de dag de nas byung 2 yang steng ngamakhanya/'og gam/ thad kur 22byung ba mi shes so/ /mi pham da pa 'di ltar lo lnga brgyar sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya ristong mang po la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po grangs med/ tshad med dpag tu med pa dag bskyed par bya ba dang ( snye/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa yongs su gzung bar bya ba de thams cad kyang the tsom 20za ba'i nyes pas bsgrubs par ma gyur pa la ltos/ mi pham ri sprepa the tsom 8gyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gnod pa chen po ji tsam du 'gyur ba la ltos/ mi pham sa pa de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' dag gisko rithe tsoms1yongs su spangs te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed la myur du danasems can 39wa 771

thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i stobs bskyed pa'i mthu thob par bya ba'i phyir gang na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo —17)bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' mi pham 92pas/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas byang chub sems dpa' yongs su grub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag gi rinosangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gan nas ji snyed cig 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi pham 5pa byang chub sems dpa' yongs su grub pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag 6bdun cu rtsa gnyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong skuphrag mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed napas/ phyir mi ldog par yongs su 'grub na dge ba'i rtsa ba de bas chung ngu rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzod par dka' ba'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig phrag bcos9brgyad 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams na de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ de'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i 'od kyi gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs dpag 39—772

med kyi gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag nyi shu 1rtsa lnga 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi sgron ma'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cu 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu zil gyis gnon pa'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdul bral 'od kyi gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' khri brgyad stong 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro//de bzhin gshegs pa dpal brtsegs kyi gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba dunaphrag brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi'i dbang po'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig phrag bcu 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs mngon par shes pa'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' nyi lke khri nyis stong 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog ca/rgyal mtshan gyi gan nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus thob ra pa/ 'jug pa gcig gis yang dag par zhugs pa/ nyi ma brgyad pa gcig gis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i 'khor ba bsnyil ba bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bar ba'i bdag po'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bcu gnyis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur 39—773

rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'jigs pa brnyes pa'i gan nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa dgu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med7)la blta ba dang ske/ phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su dri ba dang /yongs su dri bar na bya ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur rol/ /mi pham ri pa rnam nga)grangs de lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa gang dag gisko gan nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de (6)la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'dong ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi57)mtshan bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tshang bar brjod kyang mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /mi pham7pa gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos pa'i sems can de dag rnyed pa ji snyedamatho)cig legs par rnyed pa la ltos/ sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de la tha na sems dad pa gcig tsam rnyed pa dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la 1 dad pa mi phyed pa de dag ni dman pa la mos par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi pham pa 11de lta hu bas na khyod mos par bya1lha/ khyod kyis mikhong du chud par bya stel/ lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze'i skye dgu dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mdun du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung ba dang / bcang ba dang /bklag 15pa dang / kun chub par bya ba dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bstan par bya ba dang / bsgom pa la mngon par dga' bar bya'o/ /mi pham lapa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyin 1 zhag gcig tsam yang bzung zhing 33—774

sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang dag par bsngags pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gnang nyab/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chen po myur du bsgrubs napa 'di gang dag gi rin lam du grag 4pa'i sems can de dag ni rnyed pa shin tu legs par rnyed 5cing dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa dang / sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 6byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis 7brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /thos nas kyang dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po thob pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa dang / sgom 8pa la dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / tha na yi ger bris te mchod pa byed pa de dag kyang bsod nams mang du skyed 9par 'gyur te/ de bgrang bar sla ba ma yin no/ /mi pham 1 pa de ltar na 11ngas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa de byas pa yin te/ khyod 32kyang da //the tsom 1 med par brtson par gyis 5shig /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chags pa med cing sgrib pa med pa la/ som nyi ma za shig36 /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i btson 1 rar chud da 18re/ mi pham 19pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed 2 par dka'o/ /chos bstan pa rnyed 21par dka'o/ /dal ba phun sum tshogs pa rnyed par dka'o/ /mi pham 22pa ngas khyod na la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsnyad kyis 2 da khyod 25kyis mngon par sbyor la sgrubs 25shig /mi pham 2 pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su gtang ba chen po bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi na/chos mi nub par bya ba'i phyir brtson par gyis shig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' ma 'khrugs par gyis shig /39wa 776
